## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/elements/column-element.tsx
```tsx
import { useRef, useState, type PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent } from "react";
import { ElementApi, KEYS, type TElement } from "platejs";
import {
  PlateElement,
  useEditorRef,
  useElement,
  useReadOnly,
  type PlateElementProps,
} from "platejs/react";

import {
  clampAndNormalizeWidths,
  COLUMN_MIN_PERCENT,
  setColumnWidths,
} from "../../lib/commands/editor-columns";

import { COLUMN_GROUP_LAYOUT_CLASS } from "./column-classes";

export { COLUMN_GROUP_LAYOUT_CLASS };

const RESIZE_STEP = 5;
const RESIZE_SHIFT_STEP = 10;

function columnNodes(element: TElement): TElement[] {
  return element.children.filter(
    (child): child is TElement => ElementApi.isElement(child) && child.type === KEYS.column,
  );
}

function storedWidths(columns: readonly TElement[]): string[] {
  return columns.map((column) => (typeof column.width === "string" ? column.width : ""));
}

function widthNumbers(widths: readonly string[]): number[] {
  return widths.map((width) => {
    const parsed = Number.parseFloat(width);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
  });
}

function sameWidths(left: readonly string[], right: readonly string[]): boolean {
  return left.length === right.length && left.every((width, index) => width === right[index]);
}

function columnTrackTemplate(widths: readonly string[]): string {
  return widths
    .map((width) => {
      const parsed = Number.parseFloat(width);
      return `${Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 1}fr`;
    })
    .join(" ");
}

function columnWidthStyle(template: string): { [key: `--${string}`]: string } {
  return { "--column-widths": template };
}

export function ColumnElement(props: PlateElementProps) {
  return (
    <PlateElement {...props} className="min-w-0">
      <div className="min-w-0">{props.children}</div>
    </PlateElement>
  );
}

export function ColumnGroupElement(props: PlateElementProps) {
  const editor = useEditorRef();
  const element = useElement();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const columns = columnNodes(element);
  const saved = storedWidths(columns);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
  // The handle being dragged, so its pill stays shown while the pointer is captured.
  const [dragIndex, setDragIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const gridRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const dragRef = useRef<{ index: number; startX: number; width: number; start: number[] } | null>(
    null,
  );
  const shown = preview ?? saved;

  function commitWidths(numbers: readonly number[]): void {
    const path = editor.api.findPath(element);
    if (!path) {
      return;
    }

    const start = editor.api.start(path.concat([0, 0]));
    editor.tf.withoutNormalizing(() => {
      if (start) {
        editor.tf.select(start);
      }
      setColumnWidths(editor, numbers);
    });
  }

  function onResizeKey(index: number, key: string, shiftKey: boolean): void {
    const step = shiftKey ? RESIZE_SHIFT_STEP : RESIZE_STEP;
    const delta = key === "ArrowRight" ? step : -step;
    const numbers = widthNumbers(saved);
    const left = numbers[index];
    const right = numbers[index + 1];
    if (left === undefined || right === undefined) {
      return;
    }

    numbers[index] = left + delta;
    numbers[index + 1] = right - delta;
    const next = clampAndNormalizeWidths(numbers);
    if (sameWidths(next, saved)) {
      return;
    }

    editor.tf.withNewBatch(() => {
      commitWidths(numbers);
    });
    editor.tf.setSplittingOnce(true);
  }

  function onPointerDown(index: number, event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void {
    if (event.button !== 0) {
      return;
    }

    const width = gridRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect().width ?? 0;
    if (width <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    event.preventDefault();
    dragRef.current = { index, startX: event.clientX, width, start: widthNumbers(saved) };
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    setDragIndex(index);
  }

  function onPointerMove(event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void {
    const drag = dragRef.current;
    if (!drag) {
      return;
    }

    const delta = ((event.clientX - drag.startX) / drag.width) * 100;
    const numbers = drag.start.slice();
    const left = numbers[drag.index];
    const right = numbers[drag.index + 1];
    if (left === undefined || right === undefined) {
      return;
    }

    numbers[drag.index] = left + delta;
    numbers[drag.index + 1] = right - delta;
    setPreview(clampAndNormalizeWidths(numbers));
  }

  function onPointerUp(event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void {
    const drag = dragRef.current;
    dragRef.current = null;
    setPreview(null);
    setDragIndex(null);
    if (!drag) {
      return;
    }

    const delta = ((event.clientX - drag.startX) / drag.width) * 100;
    const numbers = drag.start.slice();
    const left = numbers[drag.index];
    const right = numbers[drag.index + 1];
    if (left === undefined || right === undefined) {
      return;
    }

    numbers[drag.index] = left + delta;
    numbers[drag.index + 1] = right - delta;
    const next = clampAndNormalizeWidths(numbers);
    if (sameWidths(next, saved)) {
      return;
    }

    editor.tf.withNewBatch(() => {
      commitWidths(numbers);
    });
    editor.tf.setSplittingOnce(true);
    if (event.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
      event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    }
  }

  return (
    <PlateElement {...props} className="group/columns relative my-2">
      <div
        ref={gridRef}
        data-column-layout="stack"
        className={COLUMN_GROUP_LAYOUT_CLASS}
        style={columnWidthStyle(columnTrackTemplate(shown))}
      >
        {props.children}
      </div>
      {readOnly ? null : (
        <>
          {columns.slice(0, -1).map((_, index) => {
            const widths = widthNumbers(shown);
            const left = widths.slice(0, index + 1).reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0);
            // The value is the rounded width of the column on the left. The limits match
            // clampAndNormalizeWidths, so the value stays in range.
            const leftWidth = Math.round(widths[index] ?? 0);
            const maxWidth = 100 - COLUMN_MIN_PERCENT * (columns.length - 1);
            return (
              // A resize handle is dragged and stepped with the arrow keys. It is a
              // separator, not a Button, because it does not run a command.
              <div
                key={index}
                role="separator"
                aria-orientation="vertical"
                aria-label={`Resize column ${index + 1}`}
                aria-valuenow={leftWidth}
                aria-valuemin={COLUMN_MIN_PERCENT}
                aria-valuemax={maxWidth}
                tabIndex={0}
                data-column-resize={index}
                data-dragging={dragIndex === index ? "" : undefined}
                className="group/handle absolute top-1 bottom-1 z-10 hidden w-3 -translate-x-1/2 cursor-col-resize rounded-full sm:block"
                style={{ left: `${left}%` }}
                onPointerDown={(event) => {
                  onPointerDown(index, event);
                }}
                onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
                onPointerUp={onPointerUp}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key !== "ArrowLeft" && event.key !== "ArrowRight") {
                    return;
                  }
                  event.preventDefault();
                  onResizeKey(index, event.key, event.shiftKey);
                }}
              >
                {/* The visible pill. It is hidden until the columns, the handle or its focus are active. */}
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className="bg-foreground/40 group-hover/handle:bg-foreground/60 group-focus-visible/handle:bg-foreground/60 group-focus-visible/handle:ring-ring/50 group-data-[dragging]/handle:bg-foreground/60 absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 h-12 max-h-full w-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full opacity-0 transition-[opacity,background-color] duration-150 ease-out group-hover/columns:opacity-100 group-hover/handle:opacity-100 group-focus-visible/handle:opacity-100 group-focus-visible/handle:ring-[3px] group-data-[dragging]/handle:opacity-100 motion-reduce:transition-none"
                />
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </>
      )}
    </PlateElement>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/features/editor-toc.ts
```ts
import { ElementApi, KEYS, PathApi, type SlateEditor, type TElement } from "platejs";

import type { EditorCommand } from "../commands/editor-commands";
import { headingAnchorId } from "../../components/elements/heading-styles";
import { toggleOpen } from "../plugins/editor-toggle";
import {
  TOC_DEFAULT_DEPTH,
  headingPlainText,
  isTocDepth,
  type TocDepth,
  type TocEntry,
} from "./editor-toc-outline";

export {
  TOC_DEFAULT_DEPTH,
  TOC_DEPTHS,
  TOC_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER,
  TOC_UNTITLED,
  headingPlainText,
  isTocDepth,
  shallowestDepth,
  storedTocDepth,
  type TocDepth,
  type TocEntry,
} from "./editor-toc-outline";

function headingDepth(type: string): TocDepth | undefined {
  if (type === KEYS.h1) {
    return 1;
  }
  if (type === KEYS.h2) {
    return 2;
  }
  if (type === KEYS.h3) {
    return 3;
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function tocEntries(editor: SlateEditor, maxDepth: TocDepth): TocEntry[] {
  // A synced_ref is a void and is not a heading, so a reference does not list a heading twice.
  const entries: TocEntry[] = [];
  for (const [node, path] of editor.api.nodes({
    at: [],
    match: (candidate) => {
      if (!ElementApi.isElement(candidate) || typeof candidate.type !== "string") {
        return false;
      }
      const depth = headingDepth(candidate.type);
      return depth !== undefined && depth <= maxDepth;
    },
  })) {
    if (!ElementApi.isElement(node) || typeof node.id !== "string" || node.id.length === 0) {
      continue;
    }
    const depth = typeof node.type === "string" ? headingDepth(node.type) : undefined;
    if (depth === undefined) {
      continue;
    }
    entries.push({
      id: node.id,
      depth,
      title: headingPlainText(node),
      path: [...path],
    });
  }
  return entries;
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || typeof window.matchMedia !== "function") {
    return false;
  }
  return window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
}

function openClosedAncestors(editor: SlateEditor, path: readonly number[]): void {
  for (let length = 1; length < path.length; length += 1) {
    const parent = editor.api.node(path.slice(0, length));
    if (!parent || !ElementApi.isElement(parent[0]) || parent[0].type !== KEYS.toggle) {
      continue;
    }
    const id = parent[0].id;
    if (typeof id !== "string" || id.length === 0) {
      continue;
    }
    toggleOpen(editor, id, true);
  }
}

function scrollingParent(element: HTMLElement): HTMLElement | null {
  let parent = element.parentElement;
  while (parent) {
    const overflow = getComputedStyle(parent).overflowY;
    if (
      (overflow === "auto" || overflow === "scroll") &&
      parent.scrollHeight > parent.clientHeight + 1
    ) {
      return parent;
    }
    parent = parent.parentElement;
  }
  return null;
}

function placeCaret(editor: SlateEditor, entry: TocEntry, readOnly: boolean): void {
  const element = document.getElementById(headingAnchorId(entry.id));
  if (readOnly) {
    if (!element) {
      return;
    }
    element.tabIndex = -1;
    element.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
    element.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    return;
  }
  const start = editor.api.start(entry.path);
  if (!start) {
    return;
  }
  // Selecting without focus updates the model only. The visible caret needs the editor focused.
  editor.tf.withoutSaving(() => {
    editor.tf.select(start, { focus: true });
  });
}

function revealTarget(editor: SlateEditor, entry: TocEntry, readOnly: boolean): void {
  const behavior = prefersReducedMotion() ? "auto" : "smooth";
  const element = document.getElementById(headingAnchorId(entry.id));
  const scroller = element && behavior === "smooth" ? scrollingParent(element) : null;
  if (element) {
    element.scrollIntoView({ behavior, block: "start" });
  }
  // Slate scrolls a new selection with scrollMode "if-needed". Doing that while a
  // smooth scroll is running pulls the heading to the middle of the pane. Wait
  // until the scroll finishes, when the heading is already in view.
  if (scroller) {
    let placed = false;
    const place = () => {
      if (placed) {
        return;
      }
      placed = true;
      placeCaret(editor, entry, readOnly);
    };
    let moved = false;
    const mark = () => {
      moved = true;
    };
    scroller.addEventListener("scroll", mark);
    scroller.addEventListener(
      "scrollend",
      () => {
        scroller.removeEventListener("scroll", mark);
        place();
      },
      { once: true },
    );
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (!moved) {
          scroller.removeEventListener("scroll", mark);
          place();
        }
      });
    });
    return;
  }
  placeCaret(editor, entry, readOnly);
}

export function activateTocEntry(editor: SlateEditor, entry: TocEntry, readOnly: boolean): void {
  openClosedAncestors(editor, entry.path);
  const reveal = () => {
    revealTarget(editor, entry, readOnly);
  };
  if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === "function") {
    requestAnimationFrame(reveal);
    return;
  }
  reveal();
}

function tocNode(): TElement {
  return { type: KEYS.toc, children: [{ text: "" }] };
}

export function insertTocBlock(editor: SlateEditor): void {
  const current = editor.api.block({ highest: true });
  if (!current) {
    editor.tf.insertNodes(tocNode(), { at: [0], select: true });
    return;
  }
  const at = PathApi.next(current[1]);
  if (!at) {
    return;
  }
  editor.tf.insertNodes(tocNode(), { at, select: true });
}

// Insert a table of contents as the next sibling of `path`, inside its
// container. Used by the Add picker.
export function insertTocBelow(editor: SlateEditor, path: readonly number[]): void {
  const at = PathApi.next([...path]);
  if (!at) {
    return;
  }
  editor.tf.insertNodes(tocNode(), { at, select: true });
}

export function tocAbove(editor: SlateEditor): [TElement, number[]] | undefined {
  const entry = editor.api.above({
    match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.type === KEYS.toc,
    voids: true,
  });
  if (!entry || !ElementApi.isElement(entry[0])) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return [entry[0], entry[1]];
}

export function setTocDepth(editor: SlateEditor, path: number[], depth: TocDepth): void {
  const node = editor.api.node(path);
  if (!node || !ElementApi.isElement(node[0]) || node[0].type !== KEYS.toc) {
    return;
  }
  const current = isTocDepth(node[0].maxDepth) ? node[0].maxDepth : undefined;
  const stored = depth === TOC_DEFAULT_DEPTH ? undefined : depth;
  if (current === stored) {
    return;
  }
  if (stored === undefined) {
    editor.tf.unsetNodes("maxDepth", { at: path });
    return;
  }
  editor.tf.setNodes({ maxDepth: stored }, { at: path });
}

export function removeToc(editor: SlateEditor, path: number[]): void {
  editor.tf.removeNodes({ at: path, voids: true });
  if (editor.children.length === 0) {
    editor.tf.insertNodes({ type: KEYS.p, children: [{ text: "" }] }, { at: [0] });
  }
}

export const insertToc: EditorCommand = {
  id: "block.insert.toc",
  label: "Table of contents",
  group: "insert",
  run: (editor) => {
    insertTocBlock(editor);
  },
};

export const setTocDepthCommand: EditorCommand<TocDepth> = {
  id: "block.toc.set-depth",
  label: "Table of contents depth",
  group: "action",
  isEnabled: (editor) => tocAbove(editor) !== undefined,
  run: (editor, depth) => {
    const entry = tocAbove(editor);
    if (!entry) {
      return;
    }
    setTocDepth(editor, entry[1], depth);
  },
};

export const removeTocCommand: EditorCommand = {
  id: "block.toc.remove",
  label: "Delete",
  group: "action",
  isEnabled: (editor) => tocAbove(editor) !== undefined,
  run: (editor) => {
    const entry = tocAbove(editor);
    if (!entry) {
      return;
    }
    removeToc(editor, entry[1]);
  },
};
```

```tsx
import { type KeyboardEvent as ReactKeyboardEvent } from "react";
import {
  PlateElement,
  useEditorRef,
  useEditorSelector,
  useFocused,
  useReadOnly,
  useSelected,
  type PlateElementProps,
} from "platejs/react";

import { ChevronDown, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuRadioGroup,
  DropdownMenuRadioItem,
} from "@/components/dropdown-menu";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import {
  TOC_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER,
  TOC_UNTITLED,
  activateTocEntry,
  isTocDepth,
  removeToc,
  setTocDepth,
  shallowestDepth,
  storedTocDepth,
  tocEntries,
  type TocEntry,
} from "../../lib/features/editor-toc";
import { BLOCK_SELECTED_CLASS } from "./hr-element";
import { MENU_ITEM_ACTIVE_CHECKED } from "../../lib/features/editor-menu-active";
import {
  MEDIA_TOOLBAR_CLASS,
  EditorMenuTrigger,
  EditorTextButton,
  keepMediaSelection,
} from "../ui/block-toolbar";

const TOC_DEPTH_LABEL = {
  1: "H1 only",
  2: "H1–H2",
  3: "H1–H3",
} as const;

const TOC_INDENT_CLASS = ["ps-0", "ps-4", "ps-8"] as const;

function indentClass(level: number): string {
  if (level === 1) {
    return TOC_INDENT_CLASS[1];
  }
  if (level >= 2) {
    return TOC_INDENT_CLASS[2];
  }
  return TOC_INDENT_CLASS[0];
}

export function TocElement(props: PlateElementProps) {
  const editor = useEditorRef();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const selected = useSelected();
  const focused = useFocused();
  const depth = storedTocDepth(props.element);
  const depthLabel = isTocDepth(depth) ? TOC_DEPTH_LABEL[depth] : TOC_DEPTH_LABEL[3];
  const entries = useEditorSelector(() => tocEntries(editor, depth), [depth]);
  const shallowest = shallowestDepth(entries);
  const path = editor.api.findPath(props.element);

  function runOnToc(run: () => void): void {
    if (!path) {
      return;
    }
    const start = editor.api.start(path);
    editor.tf.withNewBatch(() => {
      if (start) {
        editor.tf.select(start);
      }
      run();
    });
    editor.tf.setSplittingOnce(true);
  }

  function activate(entry: TocEntry): void {
    activateTocEntry(editor, entry, readOnly);
  }

  function onKeyDown(event: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, entry: TocEntry): void {
    if (event.key !== "Enter" && event.key !== " ") {
      return;
    }
    event.preventDefault();
    activate(entry);
  }

  return (
    <PlateElement
      {...props}
      className={cn(
        "group relative my-2 rounded-md",
        selected && focused && !readOnly && BLOCK_SELECTED_CLASS,
      )}
    >
      <div contentEditable={false}>
        {entries.length === 0 ? (
          readOnly ? null : (
            <p data-toc-empty className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
              {TOC_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER}
            </p>
          )
        ) : (
          <nav aria-label="Table of contents" data-toc-depth={depth}>
            <ol className="m-0 list-none space-y-1 p-0">
              {entries.map((entry) => {
                const untitled = entry.title.length === 0;
                const label = untitled ? TOC_UNTITLED : entry.title;
                return (
                  <li key={entry.id} className={indentClass(entry.depth - shallowest)}>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      aria-label={label}
                      data-toc-target={entry.id}
                      data-toc-indent={entry.depth - shallowest}
                      data-toc-untitled={untitled ? "true" : undefined}
                      className={cn(
                        "h-auto w-full justify-start px-1 whitespace-normal",
                        untitled && "text-muted-foreground",
                      )}
                      onMouseDown={keepMediaSelection}
                      onClick={() => {
                        activate(entry);
                      }}
                      onKeyDown={(event) => {
                        onKeyDown(event, entry);
                      }}
                    >
                      {label}
                    </Button>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ol>
          </nav>
        )}
        {readOnly || !path ? null : (
          <div
            data-toc-toolbar
            className={cn(MEDIA_TOOLBAR_CLASS, selected && "pointer-events-auto opacity-100")}
          >
            <DropdownMenu modal={false}>
              <EditorMenuTrigger
                label="Table of contents depth"
                accessibleName={`Table of contents depth, current: ${depthLabel}`}
                text={depthLabel}
                icon={<ChevronDown aria-hidden="true" />}
                onMouseDown={keepMediaSelection}
              />
              <DropdownMenuContent
                align="end"
                collisionPadding={8}
                hideWhenDetached
                onCloseAutoFocus={(event) => {
                  event.preventDefault();
                }}
              >
                <DropdownMenuRadioGroup
                  value={String(isTocDepth(depth) ? depth : 3)}
                  onValueChange={(value) => {
                    if (value !== "1" && value !== "2" && value !== "3") {
                      return;
                    }
                    const choice = Number(value) as 1 | 2 | 3;
                    runOnToc(() => {
                      setTocDepth(editor, path, choice);
                    });
                  }}
                >
                  {([1, 2, 3] as const).map((choice) => (
                    <DropdownMenuRadioItem
                      key={choice}
                      value={String(choice)}
                      className={MENU_ITEM_ACTIVE_CHECKED}
                      onMouseDown={keepMediaSelection}
                    >
                      {TOC_DEPTH_LABEL[choice]}
                    </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
                  ))}
                </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
              </DropdownMenuContent>
            </DropdownMenu>
            <EditorTextButton
              variant="destructive"
              label="Delete"
              icon={<Trash2 aria-hidden="true" />}
              onMouseDown={keepMediaSelection}
              onClick={() => {
                runOnToc(() => {
                  removeToc(editor, path);
                });
              }}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {props.children}
    </PlateElement>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/features/editor-equation.ts
```ts
import {
  ElementApi,
  KEYS,
  PathApi,
  createSlatePlugin,
  nanoid,
  type SlateEditor,
  type TElement,
} from "platejs";
import type { KatexOptions } from "katex";

import type { EditorCommand } from "../commands/editor-commands";

export {
  EQUATION_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER,
  EQUATION_KATEX_OPTIONS,
  renderEquation,
  type EquationRender,
} from "./editor-equation-render";

type KatexModule = {
  renderToString: (expression: string, options: KatexOptions) => string;
};

let katexModule: Promise<KatexModule> | undefined;

// The public @platejs/math entries import katex statically. Loading it on the
// first equation keeps that library off the first paint.
export function loadKatex(): Promise<KatexModule> {
  katexModule ??= import("katex").then((mod) => mod.default);
  return katexModule;
}

// The native plugin is not registered: its react entry imports katex statically, which would put KaTeX in the first-load bundle.
export const equationPlugin = createSlatePlugin({
  key: KEYS.equation,
  node: { isElement: true, isVoid: true },
  options: { editingId: "" },
});

export function equationEditingId(editor: SlateEditor): string {
  const value: unknown = editor.getOption(equationPlugin, "editingId");
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
}

export function openEquationEditor(editor: SlateEditor, id: string): void {
  editor.setOption(equationPlugin, "editingId", id);
}

export function closeEquationEditor(editor: SlateEditor): void {
  if (equationEditingId(editor).length === 0) {
    return;
  }
  editor.setOption(equationPlugin, "editingId", "");
}

type EquationKeyEvent = {
  key: string;
  shiftKey: boolean;
  metaKey: boolean;
  ctrlKey: boolean;
  altKey: boolean;
  defaultPrevented: boolean;
  preventDefault: () => void;
};

// Enter on the selected void opens the editor. A paragraph is not inserted.
export function onEquationKeyDown(editor: SlateEditor, event: EquationKeyEvent): void {
  if (
    event.defaultPrevented ||
    event.key !== "Enter" ||
    event.shiftKey ||
    event.metaKey ||
    event.ctrlKey ||
    event.altKey
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const block = editor.api.block();
  if (!block || !ElementApi.isElement(block[0]) || block[0].type !== KEYS.equation) {
    return;
  }

  const id = block[0].id;
  if (typeof id !== "string" || id.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  event.preventDefault();
  openEquationEditor(editor, id);
}

function equationNode(id: string): TElement {
  return {
    type: KEYS.equation,
    id,
    texExpression: "",
    children: [{ text: "" }],
  };
}

export function insertEquationBlock(editor: SlateEditor): void {
  const id = nanoid();
  const current = editor.api.block({ highest: true });
  if (!current) {
    editor.tf.insertNodes(equationNode(id), { at: [0], select: true });
  } else {
    const at = PathApi.next(current[1]);
    if (!at) {
      return;
    }
    editor.tf.insertNodes(equationNode(id), { at, select: true });
  }

  openEquationEditor(editor, id);
}

// Insert an equation as the next sibling of `path`, inside its container. The
// block menu only converts; the Add picker needs a path-targeted insert.
export function insertEquationBelow(editor: SlateEditor, path: readonly number[]): string | null {
  const at = PathApi.next([...path]);
  if (!at) {
    return null;
  }
  const id = nanoid();
  editor.tf.insertNodes(equationNode(id), { at, select: true });
  openEquationEditor(editor, id);
  return id;
}

export function setEquationExpression(
  editor: SlateEditor,
  path: number[],
  expression: string,
): boolean {
  const node = editor.api.node(path);
  if (!node || !ElementApi.isElement(node[0]) || node[0].type !== KEYS.equation) {
    return false;
  }

  const current = typeof node[0].texExpression === "string" ? node[0].texExpression : "";
  if (current === expression) {
    return false;
  }

  editor.tf.setNodes({ texExpression: expression }, { at: path });
  return true;
}

export function removeEquation(editor: SlateEditor, path: number[]): void {
  closeEquationEditor(editor);
  editor.tf.removeNodes({ at: path, voids: true });
  if (editor.children.length === 0) {
    editor.tf.insertNodes({ type: KEYS.p, children: [{ text: "" }] }, { at: [0] });
  }
}

export const insertEquation: EditorCommand = {
  id: "block.insert.equation",
  label: "Equation",
  group: "insert",
  run: (editor) => {
    insertEquationBlock(editor);
  },
};

function selectedEquation(editor: SlateEditor): [TElement, number[]] | undefined {
  for (const entry of editor.api.nodes({
    match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.type === KEYS.equation,
    voids: true,
    mode: "lowest",
  })) {
    if (ElementApi.isElement(entry[0])) {
      return [entry[0], entry[1]];
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

export const removeEquationCommand: EditorCommand = {
  id: "block.equation.remove",
  label: "Delete",
  group: "action",
  isEnabled: (editor) => selectedEquation(editor) !== undefined,
  run: (editor) => {
    const entry = selectedEquation(editor);
    if (!entry) {
      return;
    }
    removeEquation(editor, entry[1]);
  },
};
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/elements/equation-element.tsx
```tsx
import {

  useState,

} from "react";
import {
  PlateElement,
  useEditorRef,
  useFocused,
  usePluginOption,
  useReadOnly,
  useSelected,
  type PlateElementProps,
} from "platejs/react";

import { Check, Copy, Trash2, X } from "lucide-react";

import { Popover, PopoverAnchor, PopoverContent } from "@/components/popover";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/textarea";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import {
  EQUATION_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER,
  closeEquationEditor,
  equationPlugin,
  loadKatex,
  openEquationEditor,
  removeEquation,
  renderEquation,
  type EquationRender,
} from "../../lib/features/editor-equation";
import {
  EditorIconButton,
  EditorTextButton,
  focusEditorWithoutScroll,
  retainScroll,
} from "../ui/block-toolbar";
import { ScrollFadeArea } from "../ui/editor-scroll";
import { EQUATION_BLOCK_CLASS } from "./equation-classes";

import "katex/dist/katex.min.css";

type KatexModule = Parameters<typeof renderEquation>[0];

function storedExpression(element: PlateElementProps["element"]): string {
  return typeof element.texExpression === "string" ? element.texExpression : "";
}

function EquationView({
  expression,
  katex,
  empty,
}: {
  expression: string;
  katex: KatexModule | undefined;
  empty: "placeholder" | "blank";
}) {
  let body: ReactNode;
  if (expression.length === 0) {
    body =
      empty === "blank" ? null : (
        <p data-equation-empty className="text-muted-foreground text-center text-sm">
          {EQUATION_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER}
        </p>
      );
  } else if (!katex) {
    body = <div data-equation-loading className="bg-background h-8 w-full max-w-xs rounded-md" />;
  } else {
    const rendered = renderEquation(katex, expression);
    body = rendered.ok ? (
      <div
        data-equation-math
        className="text-foreground"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: rendered.html }}
      />
    ) : (
      <EquationError expression={expression} message={rendered.message} />
    );
  }

  if (body === null) {
    return null;
  }

  // KaTeX positions .katex-mathml absolutely. This scroller is the containing
  // block so that span stays inside the scrollport instead of widening the page.
  // min-w-full centers a short expression; w-max lets a longer one scroll.
  return (
    <ScrollFadeArea
      data-equation-scroll
      orientation="horizontal"
      className="relative max-w-full min-w-0"
    >
      <div className="flex w-max min-w-full justify-center">{body}</div>
    </ScrollFadeArea>
  );
}

function EquationError({ expression, message }: { expression: string; message: string }) {
  return (
    <div data-equation-error className="max-w-full min-w-0">
      <p className="text-destructive/70 text-sm">{message}</p>
      <ScrollFadeArea orientation="horizontal" className="mt-1 max-w-full">
        <pre className="font-mono text-sm whitespace-pre">{expression}</pre>
      </ScrollFadeArea>
    </div>
  );
}

export function EquationElement(props: PlateElementProps) {
  const editor = useEditorRef();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const selected = useSelected();
  const focused = useFocused();
  const editingId = usePluginOption(equationPlugin, "editingId");
  const expression = storedExpression(props.element);
  const elementId = typeof props.element.id === "string" ? props.element.id : "";
  const open = !readOnly && elementId.length > 0 && editingId === elementId;
  const [katex, setKatex] = useState<KatexModule | undefined>();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(expression);
  const textarea = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const wasOpen = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    void loadKatex().then((mod) => {
      if (!cancelled) {
        setKatex(mod);
      }
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const opening = open && !wasOpen.current;
    const closing = wasOpen.current && !open;
    wasOpen.current = open;
    if (opening) {
      setDraft(expression);
      textarea.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    if (!closing) {
      return;
    }
    const path = editor.api.findPath(props.element);
    if (!path) {
      return;
    }
    const start = editor.api.start(path);
    const node = editor.api.toDOMNode(props.element);
    const editable = node?.closest("[data-slate-editor]") ?? null;
    retainScroll(() => {
      editor.tf.withoutSaving(() => {
        if (start) {
          editor.tf.select(start);
        }
      });
      focusEditorWithoutScroll(editable);
    });
  }, [editor, expression, open, props.element]);

  function finish(commitDraft: boolean): void {
    const path = editor.api.findPath(props.element);
    if (commitDraft && path && draft !== expression) {
      editor.tf.withNewBatch(() => {
        editor.tf.setNodes({ texExpression: draft }, { at: path });
      });
      editor.tf.setSplittingOnce(true);
    }
    closeEquationEditor(editor);
  }

  function openEditor(): void {
    if (readOnly || elementId.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    openEquationEditor(editor, elementId);
  }

  function onTextKeyDown(event: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (event.key === "Escape") {
      event.preventDefault();
      finish(false);
      return;
    }
    if (event.key === "Enter" && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      finish(true);
    }
  }

  async function copySource(source: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(source);
    } catch {
      // A denied clipboard leaves the source in the block.
    }
  }

  function remove(): void {
    const path = editor.api.findPath(props.element);
    if (!path) {
      return;
    }
    editor.tf.withNewBatch(() => {
      removeEquation(editor, path);
    });
    editor.tf.setSplittingOnce(true);
  }

  const preview: EquationRender | undefined =
    katex && draft.length > 0 ? renderEquation(katex, draft) : undefined;

  return (
    <PlateElement
      {...props}
      className={cn(EQUATION_BLOCK_CLASS, selected && focused && !readOnly && "bg-muted")}
    >
      <Popover
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={(next) => {
          // A click outside the popover drops the draft. Closing after Done
          // has already written, so this path only runs while the editor is open.
          if (!next && open) {
            finish(false);
          }
        }}
      >
        <PopoverAnchor asChild>
          <div contentEditable={false} className="max-w-full min-w-0" onClick={openEditor}>
            <EquationView
              expression={expression}
              katex={katex}
              empty={readOnly ? "blank" : "placeholder"}
            />
          </div>
        </PopoverAnchor>
        <PopoverContent
          aria-label="Equation editor"
          className="w-[min(28rem,calc(100vw-2rem))]"
          collisionPadding={8}
          hideWhenDetached
          onCloseAutoFocus={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
          }}
        >
          <Textarea
            ref={textarea}
            aria-label="Equation source"
            className="min-h-24 font-mono"
            value={draft}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setDraft(event.target.value);
            }}
            onKeyDown={onTextKeyDown}
          />
          <ScrollFadeArea
            data-equation-preview
            orientation="horizontal"
            className="relative max-w-full min-w-0"
          >
            {draft.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">{EQUATION_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER}</p>
            ) : preview === undefined ? (
              <div data-equation-loading className="bg-muted h-8 rounded-md" />
            ) : preview.ok ? (
              <div
                className="text-foreground w-max"
                dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: preview.html }}
              />
            ) : (
              <EquationError expression={draft} message={preview.message} />
            )}
          </ScrollFadeArea>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2">
            <EditorTextButton
              variant="outline"
              label="Copy source"
              icon={<Copy aria-hidden="true" />}
              onClick={() => {
                void copySource(draft);
              }}
            />
            <EditorTextButton
              variant="destructive"
              label="Delete"
              icon={<Trash2 aria-hidden="true" />}
              onClick={remove}
            />
            <EditorTextButton
              variant="outline"
              label="Cancel"
              icon={<X aria-hidden="true" />}
              onClick={() => finish(false)}
            />
            <EditorTextButton
              variant="default"
              label="Done"
              icon={<Check aria-hidden="true" />}
              onClick={() => finish(true)}
            />
          </div>
        </PopoverContent>
      </Popover>
      {readOnly && expression.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="absolute right-3 bottom-2" contentEditable={false}>
          <EditorIconButton
            label="Copy source"
            icon={<Copy aria-hidden="true" />}
            onClick={() => {
              void copySource(expression);
            }}
          />
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {props.children}
    </PlateElement>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/features/editor-inline-equation.ts
```ts
import {
  ElementApi,
  KEYS,
  PathApi,
  RangeApi,
  createSlatePlugin,
  nanoid,
  type Descendant,
  type SlateEditor,
  type TElement,
  type TRange,
} from "platejs";

import { elementAllowsMarks, isStoredEquationExpression } from "../document/editor-document-schema";

// Inline equation: an inline void with one stored expression. It is not a
// block equation, so the native @platejs/math plugins stay unregistered.
export const inlineEquationPlugin = createSlatePlugin({
  key: KEYS.inlineEquation,
  node: { isElement: true, isInline: true, isVoid: true },
}).overrideEditor(({ editor, tf: { setFragmentData } }) => ({
  transforms: {
    setFragmentData(data, originEvent) {
      setFragmentData(data, originEvent);
      // The DOM text of a void is the KaTeX output, so a copied equation would
      // be written as rendered math. Only a fragment with an equation is rewritten.
      const fragment = editor.api.getFragment();
      if (!fragment.some((node) => containsInlineEquation(node))) {
        return;
      }

      data.setData("text/plain", fragment.map((node) => plainText(node)).join("\n"));
    },
  },
}));

function containsInlineEquation(node: Descendant): boolean {
  if (!ElementApi.isElement(node)) {
    return false;
  }

  return (
    node.type === KEYS.inlineEquation ||
    node.children.some((child) => containsInlineEquation(child))
  );
}

function plainText(node: Descendant): string {
  if (!ElementApi.isElement(node)) {
    return "text" in node ? node.text : "";
  }

  if (node.type === KEYS.inlineEquation) {
    const tex = typeof node.texExpression === "string" ? node.texExpression : "";
    return `$${tex}$`;
  }

  return node.children.map((child) => plainText(child)).join("");
}

export function inlineEquationNode(expression: string, id?: string): TElement {
  return {
    type: KEYS.inlineEquation,
    id: id ?? nanoid(),
    texExpression: expression,
    children: [{ text: "" }],
  };
}

// Same places as the mention: never inside a link, a void, or a block without marks (a code line).
function inlineEquationAllowed(editor: SlateEditor, range: TRange): boolean {
  if (
    editor.api.some({
      at: range,
      match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.type === KEYS.link,
    })
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  if (editor.api.void({ at: range }) !== undefined) {
    return false;
  }

  for (const point of [RangeApi.start(range), RangeApi.end(range)]) {
    const block = editor.api.block({ at: point });
    if (!block || !ElementApi.isElement(block[0]) || !elementAllowsMarks(block[0].type)) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  return true;
}

// Returns the new node's id, or null when the selection is missing or cannot hold an inline equation.
export function insertInlineEquation(editor: SlateEditor, expression: string): string | null {
  const selection = editor.selection;
  if (
    selection === null ||
    !isStoredEquationExpression(expression) ||
    !inlineEquationAllowed(editor, selection)
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const id = nanoid();
  editor.tf.withNewBatch(() => {
    if (!RangeApi.isCollapsed(selection)) {
      editor.tf.delete();
    }
    editor.tf.insertNodes(inlineEquationNode(expression, id));
    for (const [, path] of editor.api.nodes({
      at: [],
      voids: true,
      match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.id === id,
    })) {
      const after = editor.api.after(path);
      if (after !== undefined) {
        editor.tf.select(after);
      }
      break;
    }
  });
  return id;
}

export type InlineEquationRefusal = "span" | "unavailable";

// Why an inline equation cannot be inserted over the current selection, or undefined when it can.
export function inlineEquationRefusal(editor: SlateEditor): InlineEquationRefusal | undefined {
  const selection = editor.selection;
  if (selection === null) {
    return "unavailable";
  }

  if (!RangeApi.isCollapsed(selection)) {
    const start = editor.api.block({ at: RangeApi.start(selection) });
    const end = editor.api.block({ at: RangeApi.end(selection) });
    if (!start || !end || !PathApi.equals(start[1], end[1])) {
      return "span";
    }

    if (!isStoredEquationExpression(editor.api.string(selection))) {
      return "unavailable";
    }

    if (
      editor.api.some({
        at: selection,
        voids: true,
        match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && editor.api.isVoid(node),
      })
    ) {
      return "unavailable";
    }
  }

  return inlineEquationAllowed(editor, selection) ? undefined : "unavailable";
}

// The node and its path, or undefined when no inline equation has this id.
export function inlineEquationEntry(
  editor: SlateEditor,
  id: string,
): [TElement, number[]] | undefined {
  const entry = editor.api.node({
    at: [],
    voids: true,
    match: (node) =>
      ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.type === KEYS.inlineEquation && node.id === id,
  });
  if (entry === undefined || !ElementApi.isElement(entry[0])) {
    return undefined;
  }

  return [entry[0], entry[1]];
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/elements/inline-equation-element.tsx
```tsx
import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import {
  PlateElement,
  useEditorRef,
  useFocused,
  usePluginOption,
  useReadOnly,
  useSelected,
  type PlateElementProps,
} from "platejs/react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { loadKatex } from "../../lib/features/editor-equation";
import {
  INLINE_EQUATION_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER,
  renderInlineEquation,
} from "../../lib/features/editor-equation-render";
import {
  cancelInlineEquationEditor,
  inlineEquationUiPlugin,
  openInlineEquationEditor,
} from "../../lib/plugins/editor-inline-equation-ui";
import { InlineEquationPopover } from "../ui/inline-equation-popover";
import { INLINE_EQUATION_CLASS } from "./inline-equation-classes";

import "katex/dist/katex.min.css";

type KatexModule = Parameters<typeof renderInlineEquation>[0];

export function InlineEquationElement(props: PlateElementProps) {
  const editor = useEditorRef();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const selected = useSelected();
  const focused = useFocused();
  const id = typeof props.element.id === "string" ? props.element.id : "";
  const editingId = usePluginOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "editingId");
  const draft = usePluginOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "draft");
  const stored = typeof props.element.texExpression === "string" ? props.element.texExpression : "";
  // While the popover is open the preview shows the draft. The document keeps the stored source.
  const open = !readOnly && id.length > 0 && editingId === id;
  const expression = open ? draft : stored;
  const [katex, setKatex] = useState<KatexModule | undefined>();

  // A switch to read-only cancels the open draft. The plugin cannot see a read-only prop change
  // (no editor change happens), so this stays here. Removal is handled in the plugin's onChange.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (readOnly && editingId === id) {
      cancelInlineEquationEditor(editor);
    }
  }, [editingId, editor, id, readOnly]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    void loadKatex().then((mod) => {
      if (!cancelled) {
        setKatex(mod);
      }
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  let body: ReactNode;
  if (expression.length === 0) {
    body = (
      <span data-inline-equation-empty className="text-muted-foreground">
        {INLINE_EQUATION_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER}
      </span>
    );
  } else if (!katex) {
    // The raw source keeps the line the same width until KaTeX arrives.
    body = <span className="font-mono">{expression}</span>;
  } else {
    const rendered = renderInlineEquation(katex, expression);
    body = rendered.ok ? (
      <span
        data-inline-equation-math
        className="text-foreground"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: rendered.html }}
      />
    ) : (
      <span
        data-inline-equation-error
        title={rendered.message}
        className="text-destructive font-mono"
      >
        {expression}
      </span>
    );
  }

  return (
    <PlateElement
      {...props}
      as="span"
      className={cn(
        INLINE_EQUATION_CLASS,
        selected && focused && !readOnly && "bg-muted rounded-sm",
      )}
    >
      <span
        contentEditable={false}
        data-inline-equation=""
        onClick={
          readOnly
            ? undefined
            : () => {
                openInlineEquationEditor(editor, id);
              }
        }
      >
        {body}
      </span>
      {readOnly ? null : <InlineEquationPopover id={id} />}
      {props.children}
    </PlateElement>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/ui/inline-equation-popover.tsx
```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import { useEditorReadOnly, useEditorRef, usePluginOption } from "platejs/react";

import { Input } from "@/components/input";
import { Popover, PopoverAnchor, PopoverContent } from "@/components/popover";

import { isStoredEquationExpression } from "../../lib/document/editor-document-schema";
import { inlineEquationEntry } from "../../lib/features/editor-inline-equation";
import {
  commitInlineEquationEditor,
  inlineEquationUiPlugin,
  cancelInlineEquationEditor,
  setInlineEquationDraft,
} from "../../lib/plugins/editor-inline-equation-ui";
import { anchorContext, elementRect, virtualAnchor } from "./anchor-rect";
import { EditorTextButton } from "./block-toolbar";

// The node's own element, found through the editor so no ref is read during render.
function inlineEquationNodeDom(
  editor: ReturnType<typeof useEditorRef>,
  id: string,
): HTMLElement | null {
  const entry = inlineEquationEntry(editor, id);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return null;
  }

  const dom: unknown = editor.api.toDOMNode(entry[0]);
  if (!(dom instanceof HTMLElement)) {
    return null;
  }

  return dom.querySelector("[data-inline-equation]");
}

// Edits the source of one inline equation. It sits under the node and writes only on commit.
export function InlineEquationPopover({ id }: { id: string }) {
  "use no memo";

  const editor = useEditorRef();
  const readOnly = useEditorReadOnly();
  const editingId = usePluginOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "editingId");
  const draft = usePluginOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "draft");
  const mine = !readOnly && id.length > 0 && editingId === id;
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const virtualRef = virtualAnchor(
    () => elementRect(inlineEquationNodeDom(editor, id)),
    () => anchorContext(inlineEquationNodeDom(editor, id)),
  );

  // A press outside the popover and the node commits. A press on the node keeps it open.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mine) {
      return;
    }

    const onPointerDown = (event: PointerEvent): void => {
      const target = event.target;
      if (target instanceof Node) {
        if (inlineEquationNodeDom(editor, id)?.contains(target) === true) {
          return;
        }
        if (
          target instanceof Element &&
          target.closest("[data-inline-equation-popover]") !== null
        ) {
          return;
        }
      }

      commitInlineEquationEditor(editor);
    };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
    };
  }, [editor, id, mine]);

  if (!mine) {
    return null;
  }

  const invalid = !isStoredEquationExpression(draft.trim());

  return (
    <Popover open>
      <PopoverAnchor virtualRef={virtualRef} />
      <PopoverContent
        data-inline-equation-popover=""
        aria-label="Equation"
        side="bottom"
        align="start"
        sideOffset={4}
        collisionPadding={8}
        hideWhenDetached
        className="w-auto p-2"
        onOpenAutoFocus={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          input.current?.focus();
          input.current?.select();
        }}
        onCloseAutoFocus={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
        }}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          // The editor must not see keys typed here. Escape and Enter are handled in this popover.
          event.stopPropagation();
          if (event.key === "Escape") {
            event.preventDefault();
            cancelInlineEquationEditor(editor);
            return;
          }
          if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
            event.preventDefault();
            commitInlineEquationEditor(editor);
          }
        }}
        onKeyUp={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onCompositionStart={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onCompositionUpdate={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onCompositionEnd={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onPaste={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onCut={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onCopy={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onPointerDown={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onMouseDown={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Input
              ref={input}
              aria-label="Equation source"
              aria-invalid={invalid}
              className="w-64 font-mono text-sm"
              placeholder="E = mc^2"
              spellCheck={false}
              autoCapitalize="off"
              autoCorrect="off"
              value={draft}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setInlineEquationDraft(editor, event.target.value);
              }}
            />
            <EditorTextButton
              variant="default"
              label="Done"
              icon={<Check aria-hidden="true" />}
              onClick={() => {
                commitInlineEquationEditor(editor);
              }}
            />
          </div>
          {invalid ? <p className="text-destructive text-xs">Up to 4,000 characters.</p> : null}
        </div>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/plugins/editor-inline-equation-ui.ts
```ts
import {
  ElementApi,
  KEYS,
  PathApi,
  RangeApi,
  createSlatePlugin,
  type SlateEditor,
  type TElement,
} from "platejs";

import { runEditorCommand, type EditorCommand } from "../commands/editor-commands";
import { isStoredEquationExpression } from "../document/editor-document-schema";
import {
  inlineEquationEntry,
  inlineEquationRefusal,
  insertInlineEquation,
} from "../features/editor-inline-equation";
import { blockSelectionActive } from "./editor-block-selection";

// The popover edits a draft held in these options. The document is written once, on commit.
// createdUndoDepth is the undo depth before the node was inserted, or -1 when it was not created here.
export const inlineEquationUiPlugin = createSlatePlugin({
  key: "inlineEquationUi",
  options: { editingId: "", draft: "", original: "", created: false, createdUndoDepth: -1 },
}).overrideEditor(({ editor }) => {
  const { onChange } = editor;
  if (isEditorOnChange(onChange)) {
    editor.onChange = (options?: { operation?: unknown }) => {
      onChange(options);
      // A node removed while open, or a switch to read-only, closes the popover without writing.
      const id = inlineEquationEditingId(editor);
      if (
        id.length > 0 &&
        (editor.dom.readOnly === true || inlineEquationEntry(editor, id) === undefined)
      ) {
        resetInlineEquationState(editor);
      }
    };
  }
  return { transforms: {} };
});

function isEditorOnChange(value: unknown): value is (options?: { operation?: unknown }) => void {
  return typeof value === "function";
}

export function inlineEquationEditingId(editor: SlateEditor): string {
  return editor.getOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "editingId");
}

function storedSource(node: TElement): string {
  return typeof node.texExpression === "string" ? node.texExpression : "";
}

function resetInlineEquationState(editor: SlateEditor): void {
  editor.setOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "editingId", "");
  editor.setOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "draft", "");
  editor.setOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "original", "");
  editor.setOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "created", false);
  editor.setOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "createdUndoDepth", -1);
}

// Drops the popover state without writing the document.
export function closeInlineEquationEditor(editor: SlateEditor): void {
  if (inlineEquationEditingId(editor).length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  resetInlineEquationState(editor);
}

export function setInlineEquationDraft(editor: SlateEditor, draft: string): void {
  if (inlineEquationEditingId(editor).length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  editor.setOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "draft", draft);
}

// Opening another equation commits the open one first. A refused commit keeps both as they are.
export function openInlineEquationEditor(
  editor: SlateEditor,
  id: string,
  options: { created?: boolean; createdUndoDepth?: number } = {},
): void {
  if (editor.dom.readOnly === true || blockSelectionActive(editor) || id.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  if (inlineEquationEditingId(editor) === id) {
    return;
  }

  if (inlineEquationEditingId(editor).length > 0 && !commitInlineEquationEditor(editor)) {
    return;
  }

  // The commit can remove a node and shift paths, so the entry is read after it.
  const entry = inlineEquationEntry(editor, id);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return;
  }

  const stored = storedSource(entry[0]);
  editor.setOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "editingId", id);
  editor.setOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "draft", stored);
  editor.setOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "original", stored);
  editor.setOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "created", options.created === true);
  editor.setOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "createdUndoDepth", options.createdUndoDepth ?? -1);
  editor.tf.select(entry[1]);
}

// Returns false when the draft cannot be written, so the popover stays open.
export function commitInlineEquationEditor(editor: SlateEditor): boolean {
  const id = inlineEquationEditingId(editor);
  if (id.length === 0) {
    return false;
  }

  const draft = editor.getOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "draft").trim();
  if (draft.length > 0 && !isStoredEquationExpression(draft)) {
    return false;
  }

  const created = editor.getOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "created");
  const createdUndoDepth = editor.getOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "createdUndoDepth");
  resetInlineEquationState(editor);
  const entry = inlineEquationEntry(editor, id);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return true;
  }

  if (draft.length === 0) {
    if (created) {
      removeCreatedInlineEquation(editor, id, createdUndoDepth);
    } else {
      removeInlineEquation(editor, id);
    }
  } else {
    if (draft !== storedSource(entry[0])) {
      runEditorCommand(editor, setInlineEquationSource, { id, expression: draft });
    }
    selectAfterInlineEquation(editor, id);
  }
  editor.tf.focus();
  return true;
}

// Removes a node that was just created with an empty source. Any other cancel only leaves the caret after it.
export function cancelInlineEquationEditor(editor: SlateEditor): void {
  const id = inlineEquationEditingId(editor);
  if (id.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  const created = editor.getOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "created");
  const createdUndoDepth = editor.getOption(inlineEquationUiPlugin, "createdUndoDepth");
  resetInlineEquationState(editor);
  const entry = inlineEquationEntry(editor, id);
  if (entry !== undefined) {
    if (created && storedSource(entry[0]).length === 0) {
      removeCreatedInlineEquation(editor, id, createdUndoDepth);
    } else {
      selectAfterInlineEquation(editor, id);
    }
  }
  editor.tf.focus();
}

function selectAfterInlineEquation(editor: SlateEditor, id: string): void {
  const entry = inlineEquationEntry(editor, id);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return;
  }

  const after = editor.api.after(entry[1]);
  if (after !== undefined) {
    editor.tf.select(after);
  }
}

// When the insertion is the only entry since it was made, undo it and drop its redo, so
// neither undo nor redo brings the empty node back. Otherwise remove it with a new entry.
function removeCreatedInlineEquation(
  editor: SlateEditor,
  id: string,
  createdUndoDepth: number,
): void {
  if (createdUndoDepth >= 0 && editor.history.undos.length === createdUndoDepth + 1) {
    const redoDepth = editor.history.redos.length;
    editor.tf.undo();
    editor.history.redos.splice(redoDepth);
    return;
  }

  removeInlineEquation(editor, id);
}

// The caret goes to the end of the text before the node, or to the start of the block when there is none.
function removeInlineEquation(editor: SlateEditor, id: string): void {
  const entry = inlineEquationEntry(editor, id);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return;
  }

  const previous = PathApi.previous(entry[1]);
  const block = editor.api.block({ at: entry[1] });
  runEditorCommand(editor, removeInlineEquationNode, { id });

  const target = previous === undefined ? undefined : editor.api.end(previous);
  if (target !== undefined) {
    editor.tf.select(target);
  } else if (block !== undefined) {
    const start = editor.api.start(block[1]);
    if (start !== undefined) {
      editor.tf.select(start);
    }
  }
}

const setInlineEquationSource: EditorCommand<{ id: string; expression: string }> = {
  id: "inline.equation.source",
  label: "Edit equation",
  group: "action",
  run: (editor, { id, expression }) => {
    const entry = inlineEquationEntry(editor, id);
    if (entry !== undefined) {
      editor.tf.setNodes({ texExpression: expression }, { at: entry[1], voids: true });
    }
  },
};

const removeInlineEquationNode: EditorCommand<{ id: string }> = {
  id: "inline.equation.remove",
  label: "Remove equation",
  group: "action",
  run: (editor, { id }) => {
    const entry = inlineEquationEntry(editor, id);
    if (entry !== undefined) {
      editor.tf.removeNodes({ at: entry[1], voids: true });
    }
  },
};

export const toggleInlineEquation: EditorCommand = {
  id: "inline.equation",
  label: "Equation",
  group: "insert",
  isEnabled: (editor) =>
    editor.dom.readOnly !== true && inlineEquationRefusal(editor) === undefined,
  disabledReason: (editor) => {
    const refusal = inlineEquationRefusal(editor);
    if (refusal === "span") {
      return "Equations cannot span blocks.";
    }

    return refusal === undefined ? undefined : "Equations are not available here.";
  },
  run: (editor) => {
    const selection = editor.selection;
    if (selection === null) {
      return;
    }

    // A caret makes an empty equation. A selection becomes its source, and cancel keeps it.
    const created = RangeApi.isCollapsed(selection);
    const undoDepth = editor.history.undos.length;
    const id = insertInlineEquation(editor, created ? "" : editor.api.string(selection));
    if (id !== null) {
      openInlineEquationEditor(editor, id, { created, createdUndoDepth: undoDepth });
    }
  },
};

type InlineEquationKeyEvent = {
  key: string;
  altKey: boolean;
  shiftKey: boolean;
  metaKey: boolean;
  ctrlKey: boolean;
  defaultPrevented: boolean;
  preventDefault: () => void;
};

// Mod+Shift+E inserts or wraps an equation. Enter on a selected inline equation opens it.
export function onInlineEquationKeyDown(editor: SlateEditor, event: InlineEquationKeyEvent): void {
  if (event.defaultPrevented || event.altKey || editor.dom.readOnly === true) {
    return;
  }

  if ((event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) && event.shiftKey && event.key.toLowerCase() === "e") {
    event.preventDefault();
    runEditorCommand(editor, toggleInlineEquation, undefined);
    return;
  }

  if (event.key !== "Enter" || event.shiftKey || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) {
    return;
  }

  if (blockSelectionActive(editor)) {
    return;
  }

  const block = editor.api.above({
    match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.type === KEYS.inlineEquation,
  });
  if (block === undefined || !ElementApi.isElement(block[0])) {
    return;
  }

  const id = typeof block[0].id === "string" ? block[0].id : "";
  if (id.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  event.preventDefault();
  openInlineEquationEditor(editor, id);
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/features/editor-date-value.ts
```ts
// Pure date helpers for the inline date. No React, no Plate, so the static renderer can import them.
// A stored date is a calendar date only: "YYYY-MM-DD", with no time and no zone. Every conversion
// below reads and writes plain Y-M-D numbers, so no Date is ever parsed from a string.

export type StoredDateParts = { year: number; month: number; day: number };

const ISO_DATE = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/;

function isLeapYear(year: number): boolean {
  return (year % 4 === 0 && year % 100 !== 0) || year % 400 === 0;
}

// Plain arithmetic, not Date.UTC: Date.UTC maps years 0-99 to 1900-1999.
function daysInMonth(year: number, month: number): number {
  if (month === 2) {
    return isLeapYear(year) ? 29 : 28;
  }

  return month === 4 || month === 6 || month === 9 || month === 11 ? 30 : 31;
}

export function parseStoredDate(value: unknown): StoredDateParts | null {
  if (typeof value !== "string") {
    return null;
  }

  const match = ISO_DATE.exec(value);
  if (match === null) {
    return null;
  }

  const year = Number(match[1]);
  const month = Number(match[2]);
  const day = Number(match[3]);
  if (year < 1 || month < 1 || month > 12 || day < 1 || day > daysInMonth(year, month)) {
    return null;
  }

  return { year, month, day };
}

export function isStoredDate(value: unknown): value is string {
  return parseStoredDate(value) !== null;
}

// Returns the stored form for valid calendar parts, or null for anything else.
export function toStoredDate(year: number, month: number, day: number): string | null {
  if (!Number.isInteger(year) || !Number.isInteger(month) || !Number.isInteger(day)) {
    return null;
  }

  const text = `${String(year).padStart(4, "0")}-${String(month).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(day).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  return isStoredDate(text) ? text : null;
}

// The absolute label, e.g. "Oct 12, 2026". The date is built in UTC from its parts, so no
// timezone can shift it. setUTCFullYear keeps years 1-99 from being read as 1900-1999.
export function formatStoredDate(value: unknown): string {
  const parts = parseStoredDate(value);
  if (parts === null) {
    return "Invalid date";
  }

  const date = new Date(0);
  date.setUTCFullYear(parts.year, parts.month - 1, parts.day);
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
    timeZone: "UTC",
  }).format(date);
}

// The user's local calendar day, as a stored date.
export function todayStoredDate(now: Date = new Date()): string {
  const year = String(now.getFullYear()).padStart(4, "0");
  const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

// react-day-picker works in local calendar days: a picked day is the Date whose local Y/M/D
// is the day the user clicked. So a stored date becomes a local Date at noon (no DST edge at
// midnight), and a picked Date is read back with its local Y/M/D. The result is the same in any TZ.
export function storedDateToCalendarDate(value: unknown): Date | undefined {
  const parts = parseStoredDate(value);
  if (parts === null) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const date = new Date(2000, 0, 1, 12);
  date.setFullYear(parts.year, parts.month - 1, parts.day);
  return date;
}

export function calendarDateToStoredDate(date: Date): string | null {
  return toStoredDate(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth() + 1, date.getDate());
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/features/editor-inline-date.ts
```ts
import {
  ElementApi,
  KEYS,
  PathApi,
  RangeApi,
  createSlatePlugin,
  nanoid,
  type Descendant,
  type SlateEditor,
  type TElement,
  type TRange,
} from "platejs";

import type { EditorCommand } from "../commands/editor-commands";
import { elementAllowsMarks } from "../document/editor-document-schema";
import { formatStoredDate, isStoredDate } from "./editor-date-value";

// Inline date: an inline void holding one stored calendar date. It is not in @platejs/date,
// so the plugin is defined here the same way as the inline equation.
export const inlineDatePlugin = createSlatePlugin({
  key: KEYS.date,
  node: { isElement: true, isInline: true, isVoid: true },
}).overrideEditor(({ editor, tf: { setFragmentData } }) => ({
  transforms: {
    setFragmentData(data, originEvent) {
      setFragmentData(data, originEvent);
      // The inline equation's override runs first (this plugin is registered after it), so a
      // fragment with both an equation and a date is written here in full.
      const fragment = editor.api.getFragment();
      if (!fragment.some((node) => containsInlineDate(node))) {
        return;
      }

      data.setData("text/plain", fragment.map((node) => plainText(node)).join("\n"));
    },
  },
}));

function containsInlineDate(node: Descendant): boolean {
  if (!ElementApi.isElement(node)) {
    return false;
  }

  return node.type === KEYS.date || node.children.some((child) => containsInlineDate(child));
}

// A hook returns a node's copied text, or undefined to keep the default. `body` is the node's children as text.
export type PlainTextHook = (node: TElement, body: () => string) => string | undefined;

// Matches the inline equation's plain text, so a mixed fragment keeps both.
export function plainText(node: Descendant, hook?: PlainTextHook): string {
  if (!ElementApi.isElement(node)) {
    return "text" in node ? node.text : "";
  }

  const body = (): string => node.children.map((child) => plainText(child, hook)).join("");
  const custom = hook?.(node, body);
  if (custom !== undefined) {
    return custom;
  }

  if (node.type === KEYS.date) {
    return formatStoredDate(node.date);
  }

  if (node.type === KEYS.inlineEquation) {
    const tex = typeof node.texExpression === "string" ? node.texExpression : "";
    return `$${tex}$`;
  }

  return body();
}

export function inlineDateNode(date: string, id?: string): TElement {
  return {
    type: KEYS.date,
    id: id ?? nanoid(),
    date,
    children: [{ text: "" }],
  };
}

// Same places as the inline equation: never inside a link, a void, or a block without marks (a code line).
function inlineDateAllowed(editor: SlateEditor, range: TRange): boolean {
  if (
    editor.api.some({
      at: range,
      match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.type === KEYS.link,
    })
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  if (editor.api.void({ at: range }) !== undefined) {
    return false;
  }

  for (const point of [RangeApi.start(range), RangeApi.end(range)]) {
    const block = editor.api.block({ at: point });
    if (!block || !ElementApi.isElement(block[0]) || !elementAllowsMarks(block[0].type)) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  return true;
}

// Returns the new node's id, or null when the selection is missing or cannot hold an inline date.
// A collapsed caret inserts at the caret; an expanded selection is replaced.
export function insertInlineDate(editor: SlateEditor, date: string): string | null {
  const selection = editor.selection;
  if (selection === null || !isStoredDate(date) || !inlineDateAllowed(editor, selection)) {
    return null;
  }

  const id = nanoid();
  editor.tf.withNewBatch(() => {
    if (!RangeApi.isCollapsed(selection)) {
      editor.tf.delete();
    }
    editor.tf.insertNodes(inlineDateNode(date, id));
    for (const [, path] of editor.api.nodes({
      at: [],
      voids: true,
      match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.id === id,
    })) {
      const after = editor.api.after(path);
      if (after !== undefined) {
        editor.tf.select(after);
      }
      break;
    }
  });
  return id;
}

export type InlineDateRefusal = "span" | "unavailable";

// Why an inline date cannot be inserted over the current selection, or undefined when it can.
export function inlineDateRefusal(editor: SlateEditor): InlineDateRefusal | undefined {
  const selection = editor.selection;
  if (selection === null) {
    return "unavailable";
  }

  if (!RangeApi.isCollapsed(selection)) {
    const start = editor.api.block({ at: RangeApi.start(selection) });
    const end = editor.api.block({ at: RangeApi.end(selection) });
    if (!start || !end || !PathApi.equals(start[1], end[1])) {
      return "span";
    }

    if (
      editor.api.some({
        at: selection,
        voids: true,
        match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && editor.api.isVoid(node),
      })
    ) {
      return "unavailable";
    }
  }

  return inlineDateAllowed(editor, selection) ? undefined : "unavailable";
}

// The node and its path, or undefined when no inline date has this id.
export function inlineDateEntry(editor: SlateEditor, id: string): [TElement, number[]] | undefined {
  const entry = editor.api.node({
    at: [],
    voids: true,
    match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.type === KEYS.date && node.id === id,
  });
  if (entry === undefined || !ElementApi.isElement(entry[0])) {
    return undefined;
  }

  return [entry[0], entry[1]];
}

export const setInlineDate: EditorCommand<{ id: string; date: string }> = {
  id: "inline.date.set",
  label: "Set date",
  group: "action",
  run: (editor, { id, date }) => {
    const entry = inlineDateEntry(editor, id);
    if (entry !== undefined && isStoredDate(date)) {
      editor.tf.setNodes({ date }, { at: entry[1], voids: true });
    }
  },
};

export const removeInlineDate: EditorCommand<{ id: string }> = {
  id: "inline.date.remove",
  label: "Remove date",
  group: "action",
  run: (editor, { id }) => {
    const entry = inlineDateEntry(editor, id);
    if (entry !== undefined) {
      editor.tf.removeNodes({ at: entry[1], voids: true });
    }
  },
};
```

```ts
export const INLINE_DATE_CLASS = "inline align-baseline";
// A quiet chip: no vertical padding or margin, so the line height of the paragraph does not change.
export const INLINE_DATE_CHIP_CLASS = "rounded-sm bg-muted px-1 text-foreground";
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/elements/inline-date-element.tsx
```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";
import {
  PlateElement,
  useEditorRef,
  useFocused,
  usePluginOption,
  useReadOnly,
  useSelected,
  type PlateElementProps,
} from "platejs/react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { formatStoredDate, isStoredDate } from "../../lib/features/editor-date-value";
import {
  inlineDateUiPlugin,
  openInlineDateEditor,
  resetInlineDateEditor,
} from "../../lib/plugins/editor-inline-date-ui";
import { InlineDatePopover } from "../ui/inline-date-popover";
import { INLINE_DATE_CHIP_CLASS, INLINE_DATE_CLASS } from "./inline-date-classes";

export function InlineDateElement(props: PlateElementProps) {
  const editor = useEditorRef();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const selected = useSelected();
  const focused = useFocused();
  const id = typeof props.element.id === "string" ? props.element.id : "";
  const editingId = usePluginOption(inlineDateUiPlugin, "editingId");
  const stored = props.element.date;
  const valid = isStoredDate(stored);

  // A switch to read-only drops the open popover without writing. Removal is handled in the
  // plugin's onChange wrapper. This is not an unmount cleanup, so StrictMode cannot reset it.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (readOnly && editingId === id) {
      resetInlineDateEditor(editor);
    }
  }, [editingId, editor, id, readOnly]);

  return (
    <PlateElement {...props} as="span" className={INLINE_DATE_CLASS}>
      <span
        contentEditable={false}
        data-inline-date={valid ? stored : ""}
        className={cn(
          INLINE_DATE_CHIP_CLASS,
          selected && focused && !readOnly && "ring-ring ring-1",
        )}
        onClick={
          readOnly
            ? undefined
            : () => {
                openInlineDateEditor(editor, id);
              }
        }
      >
        {valid ? (
          <time dateTime={stored}>{formatStoredDate(stored)}</time>
        ) : (
          <span data-inline-date-invalid="" className="text-destructive">
            Invalid date
          </span>
        )}
      </span>
      {readOnly ? null : <InlineDatePopover id={id} />}
      {props.children}
    </PlateElement>
  );
}
```
