## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/ui/inline-date-popover.tsx
```tsx
import { lazy, Suspense, useEffect } from "react";
import { CalendarCheck, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useEditorReadOnly, useEditorRef, usePluginOption } from "platejs/react";

import { Popover, PopoverAnchor, PopoverContent } from "@/components/popover";

import { todayStoredDate } from "../../lib/features/editor-date-value";
import { inlineDateEntry } from "../../lib/features/editor-inline-date";
import {
  closeInlineDateEditor,
  inlineDateUiPlugin,
  pickInlineDate,
  removeInlineDateFromPopover,
} from "../../lib/plugins/editor-inline-date-ui";
import { anchorContext, elementRect, virtualAnchor } from "./anchor-rect";
import { EditorIconButton, EditorTextButton } from "./block-toolbar";

const InlineDateCalendar = lazy(() => import("./inline-date-calendar"));

// The node's own chip, found through the editor so no ref is read during render.
function inlineDateNodeDom(
  editor: ReturnType<typeof useEditorRef>,
  id: string,
): HTMLElement | null {
  const entry = inlineDateEntry(editor, id);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return null;
  }

  const dom: unknown = editor.api.toDOMNode(entry[0]);
  if (!(dom instanceof HTMLElement)) {
    return null;
  }

  return dom.querySelector("[data-inline-date]");
}

// Picks a day, Today, or removes the date. Each choice writes once and closes.
export function InlineDatePopover({ id }: { id: string }) {
  "use no memo";

  const editor = useEditorRef();
  const readOnly = useEditorReadOnly();
  const editingId = usePluginOption(inlineDateUiPlugin, "editingId");
  const mine = !readOnly && id.length > 0 && editingId === id;
  const stored = inlineDateEntry(editor, id)?.[0].date;
  const storedText = typeof stored === "string" ? stored : "";
  const virtualRef = virtualAnchor(
    () => elementRect(inlineDateNodeDom(editor, id)),
    () => anchorContext(inlineDateNodeDom(editor, id)),
  );

  // A press outside the popover and the chip closes it without writing.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mine) {
      return;
    }

    const onPointerDown = (event: PointerEvent): void => {
      const target = event.target;
      if (target instanceof Node) {
        if (inlineDateNodeDom(editor, id)?.contains(target) === true) {
          return;
        }
        if (target instanceof Element && target.closest("[data-inline-date-popover]") !== null) {
          return;
        }
      }

      closeInlineDateEditor(editor);
    };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
    };
  }, [editor, id, mine]);

  if (!mine) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <Popover open>
      <PopoverAnchor virtualRef={virtualRef} />
      <PopoverContent
        data-inline-date-popover=""
        aria-label="Date"
        side="bottom"
        align="start"
        sideOffset={4}
        collisionPadding={8}
        hideWhenDetached
        className="w-auto p-2"
        // The calendar's own autoFocus moves focus to its day, so the default focus move is skipped.
        onOpenAutoFocus={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
        }}
        onCloseAutoFocus={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
        }}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          // The editor must not see keys typed here. Escape is handled in this popover.
          event.stopPropagation();
          if (event.key === "Escape") {
            event.preventDefault();
            closeInlineDateEditor(editor);
          }
        }}
        onKeyUp={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onCompositionStart={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onCompositionUpdate={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onCompositionEnd={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onPaste={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onCut={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onCopy={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onPointerDown={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
        onMouseDown={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <Suspense fallback={<div aria-hidden="true" className="h-64 w-[212px]" />}>
            <InlineDateCalendar
              stored={storedText}
              onPick={(date) => {
                pickInlineDate(editor, id, date);
              }}
            />
          </Suspense>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <EditorTextButton
              variant="ghost"
              label="Today"
              icon={<CalendarCheck aria-hidden="true" />}
              onClick={() => {
                pickInlineDate(editor, id, todayStoredDate());
              }}
            />
            <EditorIconButton
              variant="destructive"
              label="Remove date"
              icon={<Trash2 aria-hidden="true" />}
              onClick={() => {
                removeInlineDateFromPopover(editor, id);
              }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/plugins/editor-inline-date-ui.ts
```ts
import { ElementApi, KEYS, PathApi, createSlatePlugin, type SlateEditor } from "platejs";

import { runEditorCommand, type EditorCommand } from "../commands/editor-commands";
import {
  inlineDateEntry,
  inlineDateRefusal,
  insertInlineDate,
  removeInlineDate,
  setInlineDate,
} from "../features/editor-inline-date";
import { todayStoredDate } from "../features/editor-date-value";
import { blockSelectionActive } from "./editor-block-selection";

// The popover holds only which chip is open. Every choice writes at once, so there is no draft.
export const inlineDateUiPlugin = createSlatePlugin({
  key: "inlineDateUi",
  options: { editingId: "" },
}).overrideEditor(({ editor }) => {
  const { onChange } = editor;
  if (isEditorOnChange(onChange)) {
    editor.onChange = (options?: { operation?: unknown }) => {
      onChange(options);
      // A node removed while open, or a switch to read-only, closes the popover without writing.
      const id = inlineDateEditingId(editor);
      if (
        id.length > 0 &&
        (editor.dom.readOnly === true || inlineDateEntry(editor, id) === undefined)
      ) {
        resetInlineDateEditor(editor);
      }
    };
  }
  return { transforms: {} };
});

function isEditorOnChange(value: unknown): value is (options?: { operation?: unknown }) => void {
  return typeof value === "function";
}

export function inlineDateEditingId(editor: SlateEditor): string {
  return editor.getOption(inlineDateUiPlugin, "editingId");
}

// Drops the popover state without writing the document or moving the selection.
export function resetInlineDateEditor(editor: SlateEditor): void {
  editor.setOption(inlineDateUiPlugin, "editingId", "");
}

// The caret goes right after the chip and the editor takes focus. Used by every close.
function finishInlineDateEditor(editor: SlateEditor, id: string): void {
  resetInlineDateEditor(editor);
  selectAfterInlineDate(editor, id);
  editor.tf.focus();
}

function selectAfterInlineDate(editor: SlateEditor, id: string): void {
  const entry = inlineDateEntry(editor, id);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return;
  }

  const after = editor.api.after(entry[1]);
  if (after !== undefined) {
    editor.tf.select(after);
  }
}

// Opens the popover on one chip. Opening another chip closes the open one first, without writing.
export function openInlineDateEditor(editor: SlateEditor, id: string): void {
  if (editor.dom.readOnly === true || blockSelectionActive(editor) || id.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  if (inlineDateEditingId(editor) === id) {
    return;
  }

  const entry = inlineDateEntry(editor, id);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return;
  }

  editor.setOption(inlineDateUiPlugin, "editingId", id);
  editor.tf.select(entry[1]);
}

// Escape and a press outside. Nothing is written, and the chip stays where it is.
export function closeInlineDateEditor(editor: SlateEditor): void {
  const id = inlineDateEditingId(editor);
  if (id.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  finishInlineDateEditor(editor, id);
}

// A calendar pick or Today. The write is one undo step, and the same day only closes.
export function pickInlineDate(editor: SlateEditor, id: string, date: string): void {
  const entry = inlineDateEntry(editor, id);
  if (inlineDateEditingId(editor) !== id || entry === undefined) {
    resetInlineDateEditor(editor);
    return;
  }

  if (entry[0].date !== date) {
    runEditorCommand(editor, setInlineDate, { id, date });
  }
  finishInlineDateEditor(editor, id);
}

// Removes the chip as one undo step and closes the popover.
export function removeInlineDateFromPopover(editor: SlateEditor, id: string): void {
  if (inlineDateEditingId(editor) !== id) {
    return;
  }

  resetInlineDateEditor(editor);
  const entry = inlineDateEntry(editor, id);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return;
  }

  const previous = PathApi.previous(entry[1]);
  const block = editor.api.block({ at: entry[1] });
  runEditorCommand(editor, removeInlineDate, { id });

  const target = previous === undefined ? undefined : editor.api.end(previous);
  if (target !== undefined) {
    editor.tf.select(target);
  } else if (block !== undefined) {
    const start = editor.api.start(block[1]);
    if (start !== undefined) {
      editor.tf.select(start);
    }
  }
  editor.tf.focus();
}

// Creates today's date at the selection and opens its popover. Escape keeps the chip.
export const insertTodayDate: EditorCommand = {
  id: "inline.date",
  label: "Date",
  group: "insert",
  isEnabled: (editor) => editor.dom.readOnly !== true && inlineDateRefusal(editor) === undefined,
  disabledReason: (editor) => {
    const refusal = inlineDateRefusal(editor);
    if (refusal === "span") {
      return "Dates cannot span blocks.";
    }

    return refusal === undefined ? undefined : "Dates are not available here.";
  },
  run: (editor) => {
    if (editor.selection === null) {
      return;
    }

    const id = insertInlineDate(editor, todayStoredDate());
    if (id !== null) {
      openInlineDateEditor(editor, id);
    }
  },
};

type InlineDateKeyEvent = {
  key: string;
  altKey: boolean;
  shiftKey: boolean;
  metaKey: boolean;
  ctrlKey: boolean;
  defaultPrevented: boolean;
  preventDefault: () => void;
};

// Mod+; inserts today's date. Enter on a selected inline date opens it.
export function onInlineDateKeyDown(editor: SlateEditor, event: InlineDateKeyEvent): void {
  if (event.defaultPrevented || event.altKey || editor.dom.readOnly === true) {
    return;
  }

  if ((event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) && !event.shiftKey && event.key === ";") {
    if (runEditorCommand(editor, insertTodayDate, undefined)) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (event.key !== "Enter" || event.shiftKey || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) {
    return;
  }

  if (blockSelectionActive(editor)) {
    return;
  }

  const block = editor.api.above({
    match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.type === KEYS.date,
  });
  if (block === undefined || !ElementApi.isElement(block[0])) {
    return;
  }

  const id = typeof block[0].id === "string" ? block[0].id : "";
  if (id.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  event.preventDefault();
  openInlineDateEditor(editor, id);
}
```

```ts
// Shared by the editor elements and the static renderer, so both produce the same markup.
// The reference is a superscript with line-height 0, so it does not grow the line box.
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/plugins/editor-footnote-ui.ts
```ts
import { ElementApi, type Point, type SlateEditor } from "platejs";

import type { EditorCommand } from "../commands/editor-commands";
import { FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY, FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY } from "../document/editor-document-schema";
import {
  footnoteDefinitionIdAt,
  footnoteDefinitionEntry,
  footnoteInsertAllowed,
  footnoteReferenceEntries,
  insertFootnote,
  selectAfterFootnoteReference,
  selectFootnoteDefinition,
  selectFootnoteReference,
} from "../features/editor-footnote";
import { blockSelectionActive } from "./editor-block-selection";

// Scrolls the node's DOM into view. Used after a jump, so the target is visible.
function scrollPathIntoView(editor: SlateEditor, path: readonly number[]): void {
  const node = editor.api.node([...path])?.[0];
  const dom = node ? editor.api.toDOMNode(node) : undefined;
  if (dom instanceof HTMLElement) {
    dom.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }
}

const REVEAL_ATTEMPTS = 20;

function revealDefinitionWhenRendered(editor: SlateEditor, id: string, attempts: number): void {
  setTimeout(() => {
    const entry = footnoteDefinitionEntry(editor, id);
    const node = entry === undefined ? undefined : editor.api.node(entry[1])?.[0];
    const dom = node === undefined ? undefined : editor.api.toDOMNode(node);
    if (dom === undefined) {
      if (attempts > 0) {
        revealDefinitionWhenRendered(editor, id, attempts - 1);
      }
      return;
    }

    scrollPathIntoView(editor, entry?.[1] ?? []);
    editor.tf.focus();
  }, 0);
}

// Edit mode moves the caret to the end of the definition and keeps focus. Read-only only scrolls.
export function jumpToFootnoteDefinition(editor: SlateEditor, footnoteId: string): boolean {
  const entry = footnoteDefinitionEntry(editor, footnoteId);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return false;
  }

  if (editor.dom.readOnly === true) {
    scrollPathIntoView(editor, entry[1]);
    return true;
  }

  if (!selectFootnoteDefinition(editor, footnoteId)) {
    return false;
  }
  scrollPathIntoView(editor, entry[1]);
  editor.tf.focus();
  return true;
}

// Jumps back to the first reference. In edit mode the caret lands right after it.
export function jumpToFootnoteReference(editor: SlateEditor, footnoteId: string): boolean {
  const entry = footnoteReferenceEntries(editor, footnoteId)[0];
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return false;
  }

  if (editor.dom.readOnly === true) {
    scrollPathIntoView(editor, entry[1]);
    return true;
  }

  if (!selectFootnoteReference(editor, footnoteId)) {
    return false;
  }
  scrollPathIntoView(editor, entry[1]);
  editor.tf.focus();
  return true;
}

// A click on a reference whose definition is missing only selects that reference.
export function selectMissingFootnoteReference(editor: SlateEditor, path: readonly number[]): void {
  if (editor.dom.readOnly === true) {
    return;
  }
  selectAfterFootnoteReference(editor, [...path]);
  editor.tf.focus();
}

export function scrollReferenceIntoView(editor: SlateEditor, path: readonly number[]): void {
  scrollPathIntoView(editor, path);
}

type FootnoteKeyEvent = {
  key: string;
  altKey: boolean;
  shiftKey: boolean;
  metaKey: boolean;
  ctrlKey: boolean;
  defaultPrevented: boolean;
  preventDefault: () => void;
};

// Enter on a selected reference jumps to its definition, the same way the date chip opens.
export function onFootnoteRefKeyDown(editor: SlateEditor, event: FootnoteKeyEvent): void {
  if (
    event.defaultPrevented ||
    event.key !== "Enter" ||
    event.shiftKey ||
    event.metaKey ||
    event.ctrlKey ||
    event.altKey ||
    editor.dom.readOnly === true ||
    blockSelectionActive(editor)
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const ref = editor.api.above({
    match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.type === FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY,
  });
  if (ref === undefined || !ElementApi.isElement(ref[0]) || typeof ref[0].footnoteId !== "string") {
    return;
  }

  event.preventDefault();
  jumpToFootnoteDefinition(editor, ref[0].footnoteId);
}

// Runs from the registered Mod+Enter shortcut. True when the caret is in a definition, which
// consumes the key whether or not a reference exists.
export function jumpFromCaretDefinition(editor: SlateEditor): boolean {
  const block = editor.api.block();
  if (
    block === undefined ||
    !ElementApi.isElement(block[0]) ||
    block[0].type !== FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  const id = footnoteDefinitionIdAt(editor, block[1]);
  if (id !== undefined) {
    jumpToFootnoteReference(editor, id);
  }
  return true;
}

// Mod+Enter inside a definition jumps back to its first reference.
export function onFootnoteDefKeyDown(editor: SlateEditor, event: FootnoteKeyEvent): void {
  if (
    event.defaultPrevented ||
    event.key !== "Enter" ||
    event.shiftKey ||
    event.altKey ||
    !(event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) ||
    editor.dom.readOnly === true ||
    blockSelectionActive(editor)
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const block = editor.api.block();
  if (
    block === undefined ||
    !ElementApi.isElement(block[0]) ||
    block[0].type !== FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY
  ) {
    return;
  }
  const id = block[0].footnoteId;
  if (typeof id !== "string") {
    return;
  }

  event.preventDefault();
  jumpToFootnoteReference(editor, id);
}

// The slash query goes and the reference and definition arrive as one undo step.
export const insertSlashFootnote: EditorCommand<{ start: Point; end: Point }> = {
  id: "inline.footnote.slash",
  label: "Footnote",
  group: "insert",
  isEnabled: (editor) => footnoteInsertAllowed(editor),
  run: (editor, { start, end }) => {
    editor.tf.delete({ at: { anchor: start, focus: end } });
    insertFootnote.run(editor, undefined);

    // The caret is in the new definition. Its DOM node appears on a later render, so the reveal
    // retries on short timeouts until the node exists, then does the same scroll and focus as a
    // reference click.
    const block = editor.api.block();
    const id =
      block !== undefined && ElementApi.isElement(block[0]) && block[0].type === FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY
        ? footnoteDefinitionIdAt(editor, block[1])
        : undefined;
    if (id !== undefined) {
      revealDefinitionWhenRendered(editor, id, REVEAL_ATTEMPTS);
    }
  },
};
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/features/editor-footnote-id.ts
```ts
import { nanoid } from "platejs";

// A footnote id links a reference to its definition. Numbers are never stored, so the id is the only key.
const FOOTNOTE_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/;

export function isFootnoteId(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === "string" && FOOTNOTE_ID.test(value);
}

// Same generator and length as the block ids the validator assigns.
export function createFootnoteId(): string {
  return nanoid(10);
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/features/editor-footnote-repair.ts
```ts
import { KEYS } from "platejs";

import { formatBlockLabel } from "../document/editor-document";
import type { Repair } from "../document/editor-document-ids";
import { FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY, FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY } from "../document/editor-document-schema";
import type { EditorValue } from "../document/editor-value";
import { createFootnoteId, isFootnoteId } from "./editor-footnote-id";

export const FOOTNOTE_NESTED_MESSAGE =
  "A footnote definition outside the top level was turned into a paragraph.";
export const FOOTNOTE_INVALID_ID_MESSAGE =
  "A footnote definition had an invalid footnote id. It was turned into a paragraph.";
export const FOOTNOTE_DUPLICATE_MESSAGE =
  "A footnote definition reused a footnote id. A new id was assigned so each definition stays unique.";
export const FOOTNOTE_REFERENCE_REMOVED_MESSAGE =
  "A footnote reference inside a footnote definition was removed.";

export type FootnoteRepairResult = {
  content: EditorValue;
  repairs: Repair[];
};

type FootnoteElement = Record<string, unknown> & { type: string; children: unknown[] };

type RepairContext = {
  seen: Set<string>;
  repairs: Repair[];
};

function isElementRecord(value: unknown): value is FootnoteElement {
  return (
    typeof value === "object" &&
    value !== null &&
    !Array.isArray(value) &&
    "type" in value &&
    typeof value.type === "string" &&
    "children" in value &&
    Array.isArray(value.children)
  );
}

// A reference cannot sit inside a definition. Every removed reference is reported.
function stripReferences(
  children: readonly unknown[],
  path: number[],
  repairs: Repair[],
): { children: unknown[]; changed: boolean } {
  let changed = false;
  const next: unknown[] = [];
  for (const child of children) {
    if (isElementRecord(child) && child.type === FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY) {
      repairs.push({
        path,
        message: `${formatBlockLabel(path)} ${FOOTNOTE_REFERENCE_REMOVED_MESSAGE}`,
      });
      changed = true;
      continue;
    }

    if (isElementRecord(child)) {
      const inner = stripReferences(child.children, path, repairs);
      if (inner.changed) {
        changed = true;
        next.push({ ...child, children: inner.children });
        continue;
      }
    }

    next.push(child);
  }

  return { children: changed ? next : [...children], changed };
}

function freshFootnoteId(seen: Set<string>): string {
  let id = createFootnoteId();
  while (seen.has(id)) {
    id = createFootnoteId();
  }

  return id;
}

function definitionAsParagraph(node: FootnoteElement, children: unknown[]): FootnoteElement {
  const paragraph: FootnoteElement = { ...node, type: KEYS.p, children };
  Reflect.deleteProperty(paragraph, "footnoteId");
  return paragraph;
}

// The first definition of an id keeps it. A later one gets a fresh id and stays unreferenced.
function repairDefinition(node: FootnoteElement, path: number[], context: RepairContext): unknown {
  const stripped = stripReferences(node.children, path, context.repairs);
  const nested = path.length > 1;
  if (nested || !isFootnoteId(node.footnoteId)) {
    context.repairs.push({
      path,
      message: `${formatBlockLabel(path)} ${nested ? FOOTNOTE_NESTED_MESSAGE : FOOTNOTE_INVALID_ID_MESSAGE}`,
    });
    return definitionAsParagraph(node, stripped.children);
  }

  let footnoteId = node.footnoteId;
  let changed = stripped.changed;
  if (context.seen.has(footnoteId)) {
    footnoteId = freshFootnoteId(context.seen);
    context.repairs.push({
      path,
      message: `${formatBlockLabel(path)} ${FOOTNOTE_DUPLICATE_MESSAGE}`,
    });
    changed = true;
  }

  context.seen.add(footnoteId);
  if (!changed) {
    return node;
  }

  return { ...node, footnoteId, children: stripped.children };
}

function repairNode(value: unknown, path: number[], context: RepairContext): unknown {
  if (!isElementRecord(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  if (value.type === FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY) {
    return repairDefinition(value, path, context);
  }

  let changed = false;
  const children = value.children.map((child, index) => {
    const next = repairNode(child, [...path, index], context);
    if (next !== child) {
      changed = true;
    }

    return next;
  });
  return changed ? { ...value, children } : value;
}

// Runs before the column and attribute repairs, so a definition moved out of a column is a paragraph.
// `reserved` holds ids already in the document. A pasted definition with one of them gets a fresh id.
export function repairFootnoteContent(
  content: EditorValue,
  reserved: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<string>(),
): FootnoteRepairResult {
  const context: RepairContext = { seen: new Set(reserved), repairs: [] };
  let changed = false;
  const next = content.map((node, index) => {
    const repaired = repairNode(node, [index], context);
    if (repaired !== node) {
      changed = true;
    }

    return repaired;
  });

  if (!changed) {
    return { content, repairs: context.repairs };
  }

  return { content: next as EditorValue, repairs: context.repairs };
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/features/editor-footnote-index.ts
```ts
import { ElementApi, type Descendant, type SlateEditor } from "platejs";

import { FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY, FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY } from "../document/editor-document-schema";
import { isFootnoteId } from "./editor-footnote-id";

// Pure index helpers. The static renderer imports this file, so it must not import commands or plugins.
export type FootnoteIndex = {
  numbers: Map<string, number>; // footnoteId -> 1-based number
  refCounts: Map<string, number>; // footnoteId -> how many refs
  definitions: Set<string>; // footnoteIds that have a definition
};

// Numbers come from document order at read time. They are never stored on a node.
export function footnoteIndexOf(value: readonly Descendant[]): FootnoteIndex {
  const numbers = new Map<string, number>();
  const refCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  const definitions = new Set<string>();
  const visit = (node: Descendant): void => {
    if (!ElementApi.isElement(node)) {
      return;
    }

    if (node.type === FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY && isFootnoteId(node.footnoteId)) {
      const id = node.footnoteId;
      if (!numbers.has(id)) {
        numbers.set(id, numbers.size + 1);
      }
      refCounts.set(id, (refCounts.get(id) ?? 0) + 1);
    }

    if (node.type === FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY && isFootnoteId(node.footnoteId)) {
      definitions.add(node.footnoteId);
    }

    node.children.forEach(visit);
  };
  value.forEach(visit);

  return { numbers, refCounts, definitions };
}

const indexCache = new WeakMap<object, FootnoteIndex>();

// Cached on the children array, which Slate replaces on every change.
export function footnoteIndex(editor: SlateEditor): FootnoteIndex {
  const cached = indexCache.get(editor.children);
  if (cached !== undefined) {
    return cached;
  }

  const index = footnoteIndexOf(editor.children);
  indexCache.set(editor.children, index);
  return index;
}

// Which reference of one footnote this node is, counted in document order from 1. Used by static HTML.
export function footnoteReferenceOrdinal(
  value: readonly Descendant[],
  footnoteId: string,
  refId: unknown,
): number {
  let ordinal = 0;
  let found = 0;
  const visit = (node: Descendant): void => {
    if (found > 0 || !ElementApi.isElement(node)) {
      return;
    }

    if (node.type === FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY && node.footnoteId === footnoteId) {
      ordinal += 1;
      if (node.id === refId) {
        found = ordinal;
      }
    }

    node.children.forEach(visit);
  };
  value.forEach(visit);

  return found > 0 ? found : 1;
}

// True when no definition sits directly above this one. Shared by the editor and the static renderer.
export function startsFootnoteRun(value: readonly Descendant[], blockId: string): boolean {
  const index = value.findIndex((node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.id === blockId);
  if (index < 0) {
    return false;
  }

  const previous = value[index - 1];
  return !(
    previous !== undefined &&
    ElementApi.isElement(previous) &&
    previous.type === FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/features/editor-footnote.ts
```ts
import {
  ElementApi,
  KEYS,
  PathApi,
  RangeApi,
  createSlatePlugin,
  nanoid,
  type Descendant,
  type SlateEditor,
  type TElement,
  type Point,
} from "platejs";

import type { EditorCommand } from "../commands/editor-commands";
import {
  elementAllowsMarks,
  FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY,
  FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY,
} from "../document/editor-document-schema";
import { createFootnoteId, isFootnoteId } from "./editor-footnote-id";
import { plainText, type PlainTextHook } from "./editor-inline-date";
import { footnoteIndex, startsFootnoteRun, type FootnoteIndex } from "./editor-footnote-index";

export {
  footnoteIndex,
  footnoteIndexOf,
  footnoteReferenceOrdinal,
  type FootnoteIndex,
} from "./editor-footnote-index";

export function footnoteNumber(editor: SlateEditor, footnoteId: string): number | undefined {
  return footnoteIndex(editor).numbers.get(footnoteId);
}

function matchingEntries(
  editor: SlateEditor,
  type: string,
  footnoteId: string,
): [TElement, number[]][] {
  const entries: [TElement, number[]][] = [];
  for (const [node, path] of editor.api.nodes({
    at: [],
    voids: true,
    match: (candidate) =>
      ElementApi.isElement(candidate) &&
      candidate.type === type &&
      candidate.footnoteId === footnoteId,
  })) {
    if (ElementApi.isElement(node)) {
      entries.push([node, path]);
    }
  }

  return entries;
}

// The first definition in document order, or undefined when the id has none.
export function footnoteDefinitionEntry(
  editor: SlateEditor,
  footnoteId: string,
): [TElement, number[]] | undefined {
  return matchingEntries(editor, FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY, footnoteId)[0];
}

export function footnoteReferenceEntries(
  editor: SlateEditor,
  footnoteId: string,
): [TElement, number[]][] {
  return matchingEntries(editor, FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY, footnoteId);
}

export function footnoteReferenceNode(footnoteId: string, id?: string): TElement {
  return {
    type: FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY,
    id: id ?? nanoid(10),
    footnoteId,
    children: [{ text: "" }],
  };
}

export function footnoteDefinitionNode(footnoteId: string, id?: string): TElement {
  return {
    type: FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY,
    id: id ?? nanoid(10),
    footnoteId,
    children: [{ text: "" }],
  };
}

// A reference sits where an inline date sits: not in a link, a void, a code line, or a definition.
export function footnoteReferenceAllowedAt(editor: SlateEditor, point: Point): boolean {
  const block = editor.api.block({ at: point });
  if (!block || !ElementApi.isElement(block[0]) || !elementAllowsMarks(block[0].type)) {
    return false;
  }

  const blocked = editor.api.above({
    at: point,
    match: (node) =>
      ElementApi.isElement(node) && (node.type === KEYS.link || node.type === FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY),
  });
  if (blocked !== undefined) {
    return false;
  }

  return editor.api.void({ at: point }) === undefined;
}

// Moves the caret to the end of the definition. False, and nothing changes, when the id has none.
export function selectFootnoteDefinition(editor: SlateEditor, footnoteId: string): boolean {
  const entry = footnoteDefinitionEntry(editor, footnoteId);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    return false;
  }

  const end = editor.api.end(entry[1]);
  if (end === undefined) {
    return false;
  }

  editor.tf.select(end);
  return true;
}

// Moves the caret right after the reference at this path.
export function selectAfterFootnoteReference(editor: SlateEditor, path: number[]): boolean {
  // The point after the node. With no text after it, the caret stays on the node instead of
  // jumping into the next block, so a toggle that holds the reference still opens.
  const after = editor.api.after(path);
  const block = editor.api.block({ at: path });
  const inBlock =
    after !== undefined && block !== undefined && PathApi.isDescendant(after.path, block[1]);
  const target = inBlock ? after : editor.api.end(path);
  if (target === undefined) {
    return false;
  }

  editor.tf.select(target);
  return true;
}

// Moves the caret right after the first reference. False, and nothing changes, when there is none.
export function selectFootnoteReference(editor: SlateEditor, footnoteId: string): boolean {
  const entry = footnoteReferenceEntries(editor, footnoteId)[0];
  return entry !== undefined && selectAfterFootnoteReference(editor, entry[1]);
}

// The id of the definition at this top-level path, or undefined for any other block.
export function footnoteDefinitionIdAt(
  editor: SlateEditor,
  path: readonly number[],
): string | undefined {
  const node = editor.api.node([...path])?.[0];
  if (!node || !ElementApi.isElement(node) || node.type !== FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY) {
    return undefined;
  }

  return isFootnoteId(node.footnoteId) ? node.footnoteId : undefined;
}

// Only Turn into and Color are hidden for a definition. Duplicate, Delete and Move stay.
export function footnoteMenuOffersTurn(type: string): boolean {
  return type !== FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY;
}

function footnotePlainText(
  index: FootnoteIndex,
  node: TElement,
  body: () => string,
): string | undefined {
  if (node.type === FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY) {
    const number = isFootnoteId(node.footnoteId) ? index.numbers.get(node.footnoteId) : undefined;
    return `[${number ?? "?"}]`;
  }

  if (node.type === FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY) {
    const number = isFootnoteId(node.footnoteId) ? index.numbers.get(node.footnoteId) : undefined;
    const text = body();
    return number === undefined ? text : `${number}. ${text}`;
  }

  return undefined;
}

function containsFootnote(node: Descendant): boolean {
  if (!ElementApi.isElement(node)) {
    return false;
  }

  return (
    node.type === FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY ||
    node.type === FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY ||
    node.children.some((child) => containsFootnote(child))
  );
}

// Plain-text copy of a reference is [n], and of a definition is n. text. Registered after the
// inline date, so a fragment with both a footnote and a date is written here in full.
export const footnoteRefPlugin = createSlatePlugin({
  key: FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY,
  node: { isElement: true, isInline: true, isVoid: true },
}).overrideEditor(({ editor, tf: { setFragmentData } }) => ({
  transforms: {
    setFragmentData(data, originEvent) {
      setFragmentData(data, originEvent);
      const fragment = editor.api.getFragment();
      if (!fragment.some((node) => containsFootnote(node))) {
        return;
      }

      const index = footnoteIndex(editor);
      const hook: PlainTextHook = (node, body) => footnotePlainText(index, node, body);
      data.setData("text/plain", fragment.map((node) => plainText(node, hook)).join("\n"));
    },
  },
}));

export function footnoteInsertAllowed(editor: SlateEditor): boolean {
  const selection = editor.selection;
  return selection !== null && footnoteReferenceAllowedAt(editor, RangeApi.end(selection));
}

// A reference at the selection end, and a new empty definition at the end of the document.
// The caret lands in the new definition. One undo removes both.
// Top-level index for a new definition with this number. It goes into the trailing run of
// definitions, before the first one with a larger number or with no reference. With no such
// run, or no such position, it goes last. Existing definitions are never moved.
export function definitionInsertIndex(editor: SlateEditor, number: number): number {
  const children = editor.children;
  const isDefinition = (node: Descendant | undefined): boolean =>
    node !== undefined && ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.type === FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY;

  let runStart = children.length;
  while (runStart > 0 && isDefinition(children[runStart - 1])) {
    runStart -= 1;
  }
  const index = footnoteIndex(editor);
  for (let position = runStart; position < children.length; position += 1) {
    const node = children[position];
    const id = node !== undefined && ElementApi.isElement(node) ? node.footnoteId : undefined;
    const existing = isFootnoteId(id) ? index.numbers.get(id) : undefined;
    if (existing === undefined || existing > number) {
      return position;
    }
  }

  return children.length;
}

export const insertFootnote: EditorCommand = {
  id: "inline.footnote",
  label: "Footnote",
  group: "insert",
  isEnabled: (editor) => editor.dom.readOnly !== true && footnoteInsertAllowed(editor),
  run: (editor) => {
    const selection = editor.selection;
    if (selection === null) {
      return;
    }

    const footnoteId = createFootnoteId();
    editor.tf.select(RangeApi.end(selection));
    editor.tf.insertNodes(footnoteReferenceNode(footnoteId));

    const number = footnoteNumber(editor, footnoteId) ?? 0;
    const at = [definitionInsertIndex(editor, number)];
    editor.tf.insertNodes(footnoteDefinitionNode(footnoteId), { at, select: false });
    const start = editor.api.start(at);
    if (start !== undefined) {
      editor.tf.select(start);
    }
  },
};

// Every reference and every definition with this id goes in one undo step. Refs go first.
export const removeFootnote: EditorCommand<{ footnoteId: string }> = {
  id: "inline.footnote.remove",
  label: "Remove footnote",
  group: "action",
  run: (editor, { footnoteId }) => {
    for (;;) {
      const refs = footnoteReferenceEntries(editor, footnoteId);
      const last = refs[refs.length - 1];
      if (last === undefined) {
        break;
      }

      editor.tf.removeNodes({ at: last[1], voids: true });
    }

    for (;;) {
      const defs = matchingEntries(editor, FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY, footnoteId);
      const last = defs[defs.length - 1];
      if (last === undefined) {
        break;
      }

      editor.tf.removeNodes({ at: last[1], voids: true });
    }
  },
};

export function startsFootnoteRunInEditor(editor: SlateEditor, blockId: string): boolean {
  return startsFootnoteRun(editor.children, blockId);
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/plugins/editor-footnote.ts
```ts
import {
  ElementApi,
  KEYS,
  PathApi,
  createSlatePlugin,
  type SlateEditor,
  type TElement,
} from "platejs";

import { FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY, FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY } from "../document/editor-document-schema";
import { createFootnoteId, isFootnoteId } from "../features/editor-footnote-id";

// The definition is a block with inline text. Its own rules are below, and it has no other keys.
export const footnoteDefPlugin = createSlatePlugin({
  key: FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY,
  node: { isElement: true },
});

function footnoteDefinitionBlock(editor: SlateEditor): [TElement, number[]] | undefined {
  const block = editor.api.block();
  if (!block || !ElementApi.isElement(block[0]) || block[0].type !== FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY) {
    return undefined;
  }

  return [block[0], block[1]];
}

// Enter splits the definition, and the block after the caret becomes a paragraph. The split is
// splitNodes, not insertBreak: at offset 0 Plate's break inserts an empty block above and would
// turn the definition itself into a paragraph. Both halves change in one batch, so normalize
// never sees two definitions with one id.
export function breakFootnoteDefinition(editor: SlateEditor): boolean {
  const entry = footnoteDefinitionBlock(editor);
  if (entry === undefined || !editor.api.isCollapsed()) {
    return false;
  }

  editor.tf.withNewBatch(() => {
    editor.tf.withoutNormalizing(() => {
      editor.tf.splitNodes({ always: true });
      const next = PathApi.next(entry[1]);
      if (next !== undefined) {
        editor.tf.unsetNodes(["footnoteId"], { at: next });
        editor.tf.setNodes({ type: KEYS.p }, { at: next });
      }
    });
  });
  return true;
}

// Backspace at the start keeps the text. The definition becomes a paragraph and nothing merges.
export function backspaceFootnoteDefinition(editor: SlateEditor): boolean {
  const entry = footnoteDefinitionBlock(editor);
  if (entry === undefined || !editor.api.isCollapsed() || !editor.api.isAt({ start: true })) {
    return false;
  }

  editor.tf.withNewBatch(() => {
    editor.tf.setNodes({ type: KEYS.p }, { at: entry[1] });
    editor.tf.unsetNodes(["footnoteId"], { at: entry[1] });
  });
  return true;
}

function footnoteReferencePaths(editor: SlateEditor, path: number[]): number[][] {
  const paths: number[][] = [];
  for (const [, refPath] of editor.api.nodes({
    at: path,
    voids: true,
    match: (candidate) => ElementApi.isElement(candidate) && candidate.type === FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY,
  })) {
    paths.push(refPath);
  }

  return paths;
}

// Live rules for a definition that the editor creates or moves. Each rule makes one change and
// returns true, so Slate normalizes again. Every path ends as a valid block, so the loop stops.
export function normalizeFootnoteDefinition(
  editor: SlateEditor,
  node: TElement,
  path: number[],
): boolean {
  if (node.type !== FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY) {
    return false;
  }

  const references = footnoteReferencePaths(editor, path);
  if (references.length > 0) {
    editor.tf.withoutNormalizing(() => {
      for (const refPath of [...references].reverse()) {
        editor.tf.removeNodes({ at: refPath, voids: true });
      }
    });
    return true;
  }

  const index = path[0];
  if (path.length !== 1 || index === undefined || !isFootnoteId(node.footnoteId)) {
    editor.tf.withoutNormalizing(() => {
      editor.tf.unsetNodes(["footnoteId"], { at: path });
      editor.tf.setNodes({ type: KEYS.p }, { at: path });
    });
    return true;
  }

  const footnoteId = node.footnoteId;
  const earlier = editor.children.some(
    (child, position) =>
      position < index &&
      ElementApi.isElement(child) &&
      child.type === FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY &&
      child.footnoteId === footnoteId,
  );
  if (earlier) {
    editor.tf.setNodes({ footnoteId: createFootnoteId() }, { at: path });
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

// Runs before the column and child-type normalizers, so a definition moved out of a column
// becomes a paragraph in place, not a lifted definition. Enter and Backspace rules are here too.
export const footnoteNormalizePlugin = createSlatePlugin({
  key: "footnoteNormalize",
}).overrideEditor(
  ({ editor, tf: { normalizeNode, insertBreak, deleteBackward, deleteForward } }) => ({
    transforms: {
      normalizeNode(entry) {
        const [node, path] = entry;
        if (ElementApi.isElement(node) && normalizeFootnoteDefinition(editor, node, path)) {
          return;
        }

        normalizeNode(entry);
      },
      insertBreak() {
        if (breakFootnoteDefinition(editor)) {
          return;
        }

        insertBreak();
      },
      deleteBackward(unit) {
        if (backspaceFootnoteDefinition(editor) || backspaceBeforeReference(editor)) {
          return;
        }

        deleteBackward(unit);
      },
      deleteForward(unit) {
        if (deleteForwardIntoReference(editor)) {
          return;
        }

        deleteForward(unit);
      },
    },
  }),
);

function containsReference(editor: SlateEditor, path: number[]): boolean {
  return !editor.api
    .nodes({
      at: path,
      voids: true,
      match: (candidate) => ElementApi.isElement(candidate) && candidate.type === FOOTNOTE_REF_KEY,
    })
    .next().done;
}

// Merging a block that holds a reference into the block above drops the reference. Backspace
// at the start of such a block after a definition moves the caret to the definition's end.
function backspaceBeforeReference(editor: SlateEditor): boolean {
  const block = editor.api.block();
  if (block === undefined || !editor.api.isCollapsed() || !editor.api.isAt({ start: true })) {
    return false;
  }

  const [, path] = block;
  const index = path[0];
  if (path.length !== 1 || index === undefined || index === 0) {
    return false;
  }

  const above = editor.children[index - 1];
  if (!ElementApi.isElement(above) || above.type !== FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY) {
    return false;
  }

  if (!containsReference(editor, path)) {
    return false;
  }

  const end = editor.api.end([index - 1]);
  if (end === undefined) {
    return false;
  }
  editor.tf.select(end);
  return true;
}

// Delete at the end of a definition would merge the next block in. A block with a reference
// stays where it is, so Delete does nothing.
function deleteForwardIntoReference(editor: SlateEditor): boolean {
  const block = editor.api.block();
  if (
    block === undefined ||
    !ElementApi.isElement(block[0]) ||
    block[0].type !== FOOTNOTE_DEF_KEY
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (!editor.api.isCollapsed() || !editor.api.isAt({ end: true })) {
    return false;
  }

  const [, path] = block;
  const index = path[0];
  if (path.length !== 1 || index === undefined) {
    return false;
  }

  const below = editor.children[index + 1];
  if (below === undefined || !ElementApi.isElement(below)) {
    return false;
  }

  return containsReference(editor, [index + 1]);
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/elements/footnote-ref-element.tsx
```tsx
import type { MouseEvent } from "react";
import {
  PlateElement,
  useEditorRef,
  useEditorSelector,
  useFocused,
  useReadOnly,
  useSelected,
  type PlateElementProps,
} from "platejs/react";

import { footnoteIndex, footnoteNumber } from "../../lib/features/editor-footnote";
import {
  jumpToFootnoteDefinition,
  selectMissingFootnoteReference,
} from "../../lib/plugins/editor-footnote-ui";
import { blockSelectionActive } from "../../lib/plugins/editor-block-selection";
import { footnoteRefClassName } from "./footnote-classes";

export function FootnoteRefElement(props: PlateElementProps) {
  const editor = useEditorRef();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const selected = useSelected();
  const focused = useFocused();
  const footnoteId = typeof props.element.footnoteId === "string" ? props.element.footnoteId : "";
  const number = useEditorSelector(() => footnoteNumber(editor, footnoteId), [editor, footnoteId]);
  const defined = useEditorSelector(
    () => footnoteIndex(editor).definitions.has(footnoteId),
    [editor, footnoteId],
  );
  const shown = defined && number !== undefined;

  // Plain left clicks only. A modifier or a block selection leaves the click to the browser.
  function onClick(event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>): void {
    if (
      event.button !== 0 ||
      event.metaKey ||
      event.ctrlKey ||
      event.shiftKey ||
      event.altKey ||
      blockSelectionActive(editor)
    ) {
      return;
    }

    // Editable would place the caret at the clicked node after this handler, so stop it here.
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.preventDefault();

    if (!shown) {
      const path = editor.api.findPath(props.element);
      if (path !== undefined) {
        selectMissingFootnoteReference(editor, path);
      }
      return;
    }

    jumpToFootnoteDefinition(editor, footnoteId);
  }

  return (
    <PlateElement {...props} as="span" className="inline align-baseline">
      <sup
        contentEditable={false}
        role="link"
        aria-label={shown ? `Footnote ${number}` : "Footnote not found"}
        data-footnote-ref=""
        data-footnote-id={footnoteId}
        data-footnote-missing={shown ? undefined : ""}
        className={footnoteRefClassName(selected && focused && !readOnly)}
        onClick={onClick}
      >
        {shown ? number : "?"}
      </sup>
      {props.children}
    </PlateElement>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {
  PlateElement,
  useEditorRef,
  useEditorSelector,
  type PlateElementProps,

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { footnoteNumber, startsFootnoteRunInEditor } from "../../lib/features/editor-footnote";

import {
  FOOTNOTE_DEF_CLASS,
  FOOTNOTE_DEF_RUN_CLASS,
  FOOTNOTE_NUMBER_CLASS,
  FOOTNOTE_NUMBER_LINK_CLASS,
  FOOTNOTE_TEXT_CLASS,

export function FootnoteDefElement(props: PlateElementProps) {
  const editor = useEditorRef();
  const footnoteId = typeof props.element.footnoteId === "string" ? props.element.footnoteId : "";
  const blockId = typeof props.element.id === "string" ? props.element.id : "";

          contentEditable={false}
          data-footnote-number=""
          className={cn(FOOTNOTE_NUMBER_CLASS, FOOTNOTE_NUMBER_LINK_CLASS)}

            event.stopPropagation();

          contentEditable={false}

          title="Not referenced"
          className={FOOTNOTE_NUMBER_CLASS}
        >
          –
        </span>
      )}
      <div className={FOOTNOTE_TEXT_CLASS}>{props.children}</div>
    </PlateElement>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/features/editor-synced-block.ts
```ts
import {
  ElementApi,
  KEYS,
  PathApi,
  nanoid,
  type Descendant,
  type SlateEditor,
  type TElement,
} from "platejs";

import type { EditorCommand } from "../commands/editor-commands";
import { formatBlockLabel } from "../document/editor-document";
import type { Repair } from "../document/editor-document-ids";
import { SYNCED_REF_KEY, isStoredSyncedTargetId } from "../document/editor-document-schema";
import { syncedTargetStatus } from "./editor-synced-repair";

export { syncedRefRepairs } from "./editor-synced-repair";
export type { SyncedTargetStatus } from "./editor-synced-repair";
import { prefersReducedMotion } from "./editor-toc";
import { toggleOpen } from "../plugins/editor-toggle";
import type { EditorValue } from "../document/editor-value";

export { SYNCED_REF_KEY };

export const SYNCED_FROM_ABOVE = "Synced from above";
export const SYNCED_FROM_BELOW = "Synced from below";
export const SYNCED_INVALID_PLACEHOLDER = "Invalid reference";
export const SYNCED_MISSING_PLACEHOLDER = "The original block was deleted.";
export const SYNCED_CREATE_LABEL = "Create synced copy";
export const SYNCED_GO_LABEL = "Go to original";
export const SYNCED_CONVERT_LABEL = "Convert to copy";
export const SYNCED_REMOVE_LABEL = "Delete";
export const SYNCED_SELECT_REASON = "Select a block to sync.";
export const SYNCED_REJECT_REASON = "This block cannot be synced.";

export type SyncedDirection = "above" | "below";

type BlockEntry = [TElement, number[]];

function elementId(node: TElement): string | undefined {
  return typeof node.id === "string" && node.id.length > 0 ? node.id : undefined;
}

function isElement(node: Descendant): node is TElement {
  return ElementApi.isElement(node);
}

export { syncedTargetStatus };

export function syncedDirection(targetPath: number[], refPath: number[]): SyncedDirection {
  return PathApi.compare(targetPath, refPath) < 0 ? "above" : "below";
}

function indexElements(value: readonly Descendant[]): Map<string, TElement> {
  const index = new Map<string, TElement>();

  const visit = (node: Descendant): void => {
    if (!isElement(node)) {
      return;
    }

    const id = elementId(node);
    if (id !== undefined && !index.has(id)) {
      index.set(id, node);
    }

    for (const child of node.children) {
      visit(child);
    }
  };

  for (const node of value) {
    visit(node);
  }

  return index;
}

function freshId(used: Set<string>): string {
  let id = nanoid();
  let suffix = 1;
  while (id.length === 0 || used.has(id)) {
    id = `${nanoid()}-${String(suffix)}`;
    suffix += 1;
  }

  used.add(id);
  return id;
}

function cloneWithFreshIds(node: TElement, used: Set<string>): TElement {
  const children = node.children.map((child) =>
    isElement(child) ? cloneWithFreshIds(child, used) : { ...child },
  );

  return { ...node, id: freshId(used), children };
}

function emptyParagraph(used: Set<string>): TElement {
  return { type: KEYS.p, id: freshId(used), children: [{ text: "" }] };
}

function targetIdOf(node: TElement): string {
  return typeof node.targetBlockId === "string" ? node.targetBlockId : "";
}

function materializeElement(
  node: TElement,
  path: number[],
  index: Map<string, TElement>,
  used: Set<string>,
  losses: Repair[],
): TElement {
  if (node.type === SYNCED_REF_KEY) {
    const targetId = targetIdOf(node);
    const target = isStoredSyncedTargetId(targetId) ? index.get(targetId) : undefined;
    const status = syncedTargetStatus(target, targetId);
    if (status !== "live" || target === undefined) {
      losses.push({
        path,
        message:
          status === "missing"
            ? `${formatBlockLabel(path)} points at a block that is not in the document. The reference was removed.`
            : `${formatBlockLabel(path)} points at a block that cannot be synced. The reference was removed.`,
      });
      return emptyParagraph(used);
    }

    return cloneWithFreshIds(target, used);
  }

  let changed = false;
  const children = node.children.map((child, childIndex) => {
    if (!isElement(child)) {
      return child;
    }

    const next = materializeElement(child, [...path, childIndex], index, used, losses);
    if (next !== child) {
      changed = true;
    }

    return next;
  });

  if (!changed) {
    return node;
  }

  return { ...node, children };
}

// The future exporter and read-only renderer (DEV-128) must call this before writing the document out.
export function materializeSyncedRefs(value: EditorValue): {
  value: EditorValue;
  losses: Repair[];
} {
  const index = indexElements(value);
  const used = new Set(index.keys());
  const losses: Repair[] = [];
  let changed = false;
  const next = value.map((node, nodeIndex) => {
    const materialized = materializeElement(node, [nodeIndex], index, used, losses);
    if (materialized !== node) {
      changed = true;
    }

    return materialized;
  });

  return { value: changed ? next : value, losses };
}

export function findBlockById(editor: SlateEditor, id: string): BlockEntry | undefined {
  for (const entry of editor.api.nodes({
    at: [],
    match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.id === id,
    voids: true,
  })) {
    if (ElementApi.isElement(entry[0])) {
      return [entry[0], entry[1]];
    }
  }

  return undefined;
}

function nodeAt(editor: SlateEditor, path: number[]): BlockEntry | undefined {
  const entry = editor.api.node(path);
  if (!entry || !ElementApi.isElement(entry[0])) {
    return undefined;
  }

  return [entry[0], entry[1]];
}

function selectedSyncedRef(editor: SlateEditor): BlockEntry | undefined {
  for (const entry of editor.api.nodes({
    match: (node) => ElementApi.isElement(node) && node.type === SYNCED_REF_KEY,
    voids: true,
    mode: "lowest",
  })) {
    if (ElementApi.isElement(entry[0])) {
      return [entry[0], entry[1]];
    }
  }

  return undefined;
}

function isEditable(editor: SlateEditor): boolean {
  return editor.dom.readOnly !== true;
}

function isSyncableBlock(node: TElement): boolean {
  const id = elementId(node);
  if (id === undefined) {
    return false;
  }

  return syncedTargetStatus(node, id) === "live";
}

export function createSyncedRefReason(editor: SlateEditor): string | undefined {
  const current = editor.api.block({ highest: true });
  if (!current || !ElementApi.isElement(current[0]) || elementId(current[0]) === undefined) {
    return SYNCED_SELECT_REASON;
  }

  if (!isSyncableBlock(current[0])) {
    return SYNCED_REJECT_REASON;
  }

  return undefined;
}

function syncedRefNode(id: string, targetBlockId: string): TElement {
  return {
    type: SYNCED_REF_KEY,
    id,
    targetBlockId,
    children: [{ text: "" }],
  };
}

export function insertSyncedRef(editor: SlateEditor): boolean {
  if (!isEditable(editor) || createSyncedRefReason(editor) !== undefined) {
    return false;
  }

  const current = editor.api.block({ highest: true });
  if (!current || !ElementApi.isElement(current[0])) {
    return false;
  }

  const targetId = elementId(current[0]);
  const at = PathApi.next(current[1]);
  if (targetId === undefined || !at) {
    return false;
  }

  editor.tf.insertNodes(syncedRefNode(nanoid(), targetId), { at, select: true });
  return true;
}

function openAncestorToggles(editor: SlateEditor, path: readonly number[]): void {
  for (let length = 1; length < path.length; length += 1) {
    const parent = editor.api.node(path.slice(0, length));
    if (!parent || !ElementApi.isElement(parent[0]) || parent[0].type !== KEYS.toggle) {
      continue;
    }

    const id = elementId(parent[0]);
    if (id === undefined) {
      continue;
    }

    toggleOpen(editor, id, true);
  }
}

function scrollToBlock(editor: SlateEditor, node: TElement): void {
  const dom = editor.api.toDOMNode(node);
  if (!(dom instanceof HTMLElement) || typeof dom.scrollIntoView !== "function") {
    return;
  }

  dom.scrollIntoView({
    behavior: prefersReducedMotion() ? "auto" : "smooth",
    block: "start",
  });
}

export function goToSyncedOriginal(editor: SlateEditor, at?: number[]): void {
  if (!isEditable(editor)) {
    return;
  }

  const refEntry = at === undefined ? selectedSyncedRef(editor) : nodeAt(editor, at);
  if (!refEntry || refEntry[0].type !== SYNCED_REF_KEY) {
    return;
  }

  const targetId = targetIdOf(refEntry[0]);
  const target = isStoredSyncedTargetId(targetId) ? findBlockById(editor, targetId) : undefined;
  if (!target || syncedTargetStatus(target[0], targetId) !== "live") {
    return;
  }

  openAncestorToggles(editor, target[1]);
  const start = editor.api.start(target[1]);
  if (!start) {
    return;
  }

  editor.tf.withoutSaving(() => {
    editor.tf.select(start, { focus: true });
  });
  scrollToBlock(editor, target[0]);
}

function collectIds(value: readonly Descendant[]): Set<string> {
  return new Set(indexElements(value).keys());
}

export function convertSyncedRefAt(editor: SlateEditor, path: number[]): boolean {
  if (!isEditable(editor)) {
    return false;
  }

  const refEntry = nodeAt(editor, path);
  if (!refEntry || refEntry[0].type !== SYNCED_REF_KEY) {
    return false;
  }

  const targetId = targetIdOf(refEntry[0]);
  const target = isStoredSyncedTargetId(targetId) ? findBlockById(editor, targetId) : undefined;
  if (!target || syncedTargetStatus(target[0], targetId) !== "live") {
    return false;
  }

  const clone = cloneWithFreshIds(target[0], collectIds(editor.children));
  editor.tf.withoutNormalizing(() => {
    editor.tf.removeNodes({ at: path, voids: true });
    editor.tf.insertNodes(clone, { at: path, select: true });
  });
  return true;
}

export function removeSyncedRefAt(editor: SlateEditor, path: number[]): boolean {
  if (!isEditable(editor)) {
    return false;
  }

  const refEntry = nodeAt(editor, path);
  if (!refEntry || refEntry[0].type !== SYNCED_REF_KEY) {
    return false;
  }

  editor.tf.removeNodes({ at: path, voids: true });
  if (editor.children.length === 0) {
    editor.tf.insertNodes({ type: KEYS.p, children: [{ text: "" }] }, { at: [0] });
  }

  return true;
}

type KeyEvent = {
  key: string;
  shiftKey: boolean;
  metaKey: boolean;
  ctrlKey: boolean;
  altKey: boolean;
  defaultPrevented: boolean;
  preventDefault: () => void;
};

export function onSyncedRefKeyDown(editor: SlateEditor, event: KeyEvent): void {
  if (
    event.defaultPrevented ||
    event.key !== "Enter" ||
    event.shiftKey ||
    event.metaKey ||
    event.ctrlKey ||
    event.altKey ||
    !isEditable(editor)
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const block = editor.api.block();
  if (!block || !ElementApi.isElement(block[0]) || block[0].type !== SYNCED_REF_KEY) {
    return;
  }

  event.preventDefault();
  goToSyncedOriginal(editor, block[1]);
}

function selectedTargetIsLive(editor: SlateEditor): boolean {
  const selected = selectedSyncedRef(editor);
  if (!selected) {
    return false;
  }

  const targetId = targetIdOf(selected[0]);
  const target = isStoredSyncedTargetId(targetId) ? findBlockById(editor, targetId) : undefined;
  return syncedTargetStatus(target?.[0], targetId) === "live";
}

export const createSyncedRef: EditorCommand = {
  id: "block.synced.create-ref",
  label: SYNCED_CREATE_LABEL,
  group: "insert",
  isEnabled: (editor) => isEditable(editor) && createSyncedRefReason(editor) === undefined,
  disabledReason: (editor) => createSyncedRefReason(editor),
  run: (editor) => {
    insertSyncedRef(editor);
  },
};

export const goToSyncedOriginalCommand: EditorCommand = {
  id: "block.synced.go-to-original",
  label: SYNCED_GO_LABEL,
  group: "action",
  isEnabled: (editor) => isEditable(editor) && selectedTargetIsLive(editor),
  run: (editor) => {
    goToSyncedOriginal(editor);
  },
};

export const convertSyncedRef: EditorCommand = {
  id: "block.synced.convert",
  label: SYNCED_CONVERT_LABEL,
  group: "action",
  isEnabled: (editor) => isEditable(editor) && selectedTargetIsLive(editor),
  run: (editor) => {
    const selected = selectedSyncedRef(editor);
    if (!selected) {
      return;
    }

    convertSyncedRefAt(editor, selected[1]);
  },
};

export const removeSyncedRef: EditorCommand = {
  id: "block.synced.remove",
  label: SYNCED_REMOVE_LABEL,
  group: "action",
  isEnabled: (editor) => isEditable(editor) && selectedSyncedRef(editor) !== undefined,
  run: (editor) => {
    const selected = selectedSyncedRef(editor);
    if (!selected) {
      return;
    }

    removeSyncedRefAt(editor, selected[1]);
  },
};
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/elements/synced-ref-element.tsx
```tsx
import { createElement, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Copy, CornerUpLeft, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { ElementApi, type Descendant, type SlateEditor, type TElement, type TText } from "platejs";
import { pipeRenderLeafStatic } from "platejs/static";
import {
  ElementProvider,
  PlateElement,
  useEditorRef,
  useEditorSelector,
  useFocused,
  useReadOnly,
  useSelected,
  type PlateElementProps,
} from "platejs/react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import {
  SYNCED_CONVERT_LABEL,
  SYNCED_FROM_ABOVE,
  SYNCED_FROM_BELOW,
  SYNCED_GO_LABEL,
  SYNCED_INVALID_PLACEHOLDER,
  SYNCED_MISSING_PLACEHOLDER,
  SYNCED_REF_KEY,
  SYNCED_REMOVE_LABEL,
  convertSyncedRefAt,
  findBlockById,
  goToSyncedOriginal,
  removeSyncedRefAt,
  syncedDirection,
  syncedTargetStatus,
  type SyncedDirection,
  type SyncedTargetStatus,
} from "../../lib/features/editor-synced-block";
import { isStoredSyncedTargetId } from "../../lib/document/editor-document-schema";
import { BLOCK_SELECTED_CLASS } from "./hr-element";
import { MEDIA_TOOLBAR_CLASS, EditorTextButton, keepMediaSelection } from "../ui/block-toolbar";
import { ScrollFadeArea } from "../ui/editor-scroll";

// PlateStatic (static-CTmHK15f.js:599) assigns `editor.children = value`, so it
// cannot render a target inside the live editor. pluginRenderElementStatic
// (static-CTmHK15f.js:352) also skips ElementProvider, which the react renderer
// wraps at react/index.js:1799. useElement() would then see this reference.
// A nested editor has no media runtime and its own history. This walker reuses
// the main editor's element and leaf components instead.

const PREVIEW_ROOT = 1_000_000;

type PreviewProps = {
  attributes: PlateElementProps["attributes"];
  element: TElement;
  children?: ReactNode;
  path: number[];
  editor: SlateEditor;
};

type ElementRenderer = (props: PreviewProps) => ReactNode;

type PreviewView = {
  status: SyncedTargetStatus;
  node: TElement | undefined;
  direction: SyncedDirection | undefined;
};

function isText(node: Descendant): node is TText {
  return !ElementApi.isElement(node);
}

function isElementRenderer(value: unknown): value is ElementRenderer {
  return typeof value === "function";
}

function elementRenderer(editor: SlateEditor, type: string): ElementRenderer | undefined {
  // React editors index element components by node type. The static isElement
  // cache is not built for them (withSlate pluginCache.node has types, not isElement).
  const types: unknown = editor.meta.pluginCache.node.types;
  const key =
    typeof types === "object" && types !== null && type in types
      ? Reflect.get(types, type)
      : undefined;
  if (typeof key !== "string") {
    return undefined;
  }

  const component: unknown = editor.meta.components?.[key];
  if (isElementRenderer(component)) {
    return component;
  }

  const render: unknown = editor.getPlugin({ key }).render?.node;
  return isElementRenderer(render) ? render : undefined;
}

function previewTree(node: Descendant): Descendant {
  if (!ElementApi.isElement(node)) {
    return node;
  }

  const children = node.children.map((child) => previewTree(child));
  const copy: TElement = { ...node, children };
  if (
    (node.type === "h1" || node.type === "h2" || node.type === "h3") &&
    typeof node.id === "string" &&
    node.id.length > 0
  ) {
    copy.id = `preview-${node.id}`;
  }

  return copy;
}

function previewAttributes(path: number[]): PlateElementProps["attributes"] {
  return {
    "data-slate-node": "element",
    ref: () => undefined,
    "data-preview-path": path.join("."),
  };
}

function PreviewText({ editor, text, path }: { editor: SlateEditor; text: TText; path: number[] }) {
  const renderLeaf = pipeRenderLeafStatic(editor);
  const shown = text.text.length === 0 ? "\uFEFF" : text.text;
  return renderLeaf({
    attributes: { "data-slate-leaf": true },
    children: shown,
    leaf: text,
    text,
    path,
  });
}

function PreviewNode({
  editor,
  node,
  path,
}: {
  editor: SlateEditor;
  node: Descendant;
  path: number[];
}) {
  if (isText(node)) {
    return <PreviewText editor={editor} text={node} path={path} />;
  }

  if (node.type === SYNCED_REF_KEY) {
    return <p>{SYNCED_INVALID_PLACEHOLDER}</p>;
  }

  const children = node.children.map((child, index) => (
    <PreviewNode
      key={path.concat(index).join(".")}
      editor={editor}
      node={child}
      path={path.concat(index)}
    />
  ));
  const renderer = elementRenderer(editor, node.type);

  return (
    <ElementProvider element={node} entry={[node, path]} path={path}>
      {renderer === undefined ? (
        <div>{children}</div>
      ) : (
        createElement(
          renderer,
          {
            attributes: previewAttributes(path),
            editor,
            element: node,
            path,
          },
          children,
        )
      )}
    </ElementProvider>
  );
}

function SyncedPreview({ node }: { node: TElement }) {
  "use no memo";
  const editor = useEditorRef();
  const preview = previewTree(node);
  if (!ElementApi.isElement(preview)) {
    return null;
  }

  return <PreviewNode editor={editor} node={preview} path={[PREVIEW_ROOT]} />;
}

function targetId(element: PlateElementProps["element"]): string {
  return typeof element.targetBlockId === "string" ? element.targetBlockId : "";
}

function refLabel(direction: SyncedDirection | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (direction === "above") {
    return SYNCED_FROM_ABOVE;
  }

  if (direction === "below") {
    return SYNCED_FROM_BELOW;
  }

  return undefined;
}

export function SyncedRefElement(props: PlateElementProps) {
  "use no memo";
  const editor = useEditorRef();
  const readOnly = useReadOnly();
  const selected = useSelected();
  const focused = useFocused();
  const storedTargetId = targetId(props.element);
  const view = useEditorSelector((): PreviewView => {
    const refPath = editor.api.findPath(props.element);
    const found = isStoredSyncedTargetId(storedTargetId)
      ? findBlockById(editor, storedTargetId)
      : undefined;
    const status = syncedTargetStatus(found?.[0], storedTargetId);
    const direction =
      status === "live" && found && refPath ? syncedDirection(found[1], refPath) : undefined;
    return { status, node: found?.[0], direction };
  }, [storedTargetId, props.element]);
  const label = refLabel(view.direction);
  const path = editor.api.findPath(props.element);

  function selectRef(): void {
    if (!path) {
      return;
    }

    const start = editor.api.start(path);
    if (!start) {
      return;
    }

    editor.tf.withoutSaving(() => {
      editor.tf.select(start);
    });
  }

  function runOnRef(run: (refPath: number[]) => void): void {
    if (!path || readOnly) {
      return;
    }

    editor.tf.withNewBatch(() => {
      run(path);
    });
    editor.tf.setSplittingOnce(true);
  }

  return (
    <PlateElement
      {...props}
      className={cn(
        "group border-border relative my-2 max-w-full min-w-0 rounded-md border-s ps-3",
        selected && focused && !readOnly && BLOCK_SELECTED_CLASS,
      )}
    >
      <div
        contentEditable={false}
        data-synced-ref=""
        data-synced-state={view.status}
        onMouseDown={selectRef}
      >
        {label === undefined ? null : (
          <p data-synced-label className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">
            {label}
          </p>
        )}
        {view.status === "live" && view.node ? (
          <ScrollFadeArea
            data-synced-preview
            orientation="horizontal"
            className="pointer-events-none max-w-full min-w-0"
          >
            <SyncedPreview node={view.node} />
          </ScrollFadeArea>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
            {view.status === "missing" ? SYNCED_MISSING_PLACEHOLDER : SYNCED_INVALID_PLACEHOLDER}
          </p>
        )}
        {readOnly ? null : (
          <div
            data-synced-toolbar
            className={cn(MEDIA_TOOLBAR_CLASS, selected && "pointer-events-auto opacity-100")}
            onMouseDown={(event) => {
              // Selecting the void here replaces these buttons before click fires.
              event.stopPropagation();
            }}
            onClick={(event) => {
              event.stopPropagation();
            }}
          >
            {view.status === "live" ? (
              <EditorTextButton
                label={SYNCED_GO_LABEL}
                icon={<CornerUpLeft aria-hidden="true" />}
                onMouseDown={keepMediaSelection}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (path) {
                    goToSyncedOriginal(editor, path);
                  }
                }}
              />
            ) : null}
            {view.status === "live" ? (
              <EditorTextButton
                label={SYNCED_CONVERT_LABEL}
                icon={<Copy aria-hidden="true" />}
                onMouseDown={keepMediaSelection}
                onClick={() => {
                  runOnRef((refPath) => {
                    convertSyncedRefAt(editor, refPath);
                  });
                }}
              />
            ) : null}
            <EditorTextButton
              variant="destructive"
              label={SYNCED_REMOVE_LABEL}
              icon={<Trash2 aria-hidden="true" />}
              onMouseDown={keepMediaSelection}
              onClick={() => {
                runOnRef((refPath) => {
                  removeSyncedRefAt(editor, refPath);
                });
              }}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </PlateElement>
  );
}
```
