## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/editor/editor-save-status.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { EditorTextButton } from "../ui/block-toolbar";

import type { AutosaveStatus } from "../../lib/document/editor-autosave";

type EditorSaveStatusProps = {
  status: AutosaveStatus;
  message?: string;
  onRetry: () => void;
};

const FALLBACK_ERROR =
  "The document could not be saved. Copy it before closing this tab, then try again.";

function statusText(status: AutosaveStatus, message: string | undefined): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "saved":
      return "Saved";
    case "saving":
      return "Saving…";
    case "dirty":
      return "Unsaved changes";
    case "conflict":
      return "Changed in another tab. Your copy was saved for recovery. Reload to continue.";
    case "error":
      return message && message.length > 0 ? message : FALLBACK_ERROR;
  }
}

// The healthy states are silent: no "Saved"/"Saving…"/"Unsaved changes" label.
// Only the failure states are visible, because they are the only way the user
// learns their text is not being saved. This is a deliberate exception.
export function EditorSaveStatus({ status, message, onRetry }: EditorSaveStatusProps) {
  if (status !== "error" && status !== "conflict") {
    return null;
  }
  const isError = status === "error";

  return (
    <div
      aria-live="polite"
      className={cn(
        "flex max-w-full flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2 text-right text-sm text-pretty",
        isError ? "text-destructive" : "text-muted-foreground",
      )}
    >
      <span>{statusText(status, message)}</span>
      {isError ? (
        <EditorTextButton
          variant="outline"
          label="Retry"
          icon={<RefreshCw aria-hidden="true" />}
          onClick={onRetry}
        />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/editor/editor-recovery-notice.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";

import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "@/components/alert";
import { CopyButton } from "@/components/copy-button";
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger } from "@/components/tooltip";

import { EditorTextButton } from "../ui/block-toolbar";
import { ScrollFadeArea } from "../ui/editor-scroll";

import { EDITOR_SCHEMA_VERSION } from "../../lib/document/editor-document";
import type { EditorRecoveryResult } from "../../hooks/use-editor-document";

type EditorRecoveryNoticeProps = {
  result: EditorRecoveryResult;
  raw: unknown;
  error?: string;
  onStartOver: () => void;
};

function titleFor(result: EditorRecoveryResult): string {
  switch (result.status) {
    case "invalid":
      return "This document could not be read";
    case "unsupported":
      return "This document uses unsupported content";
    case "future-version":
      return "This document is from a newer editor";
  }
}

function detailFor(result: EditorRecoveryResult): string {
  switch (result.status) {
    case "invalid":
      return "The saved document is not valid. Copy the JSON if you need it, or start over. The original stays in recovery storage.";
    case "unsupported":
      return "This editor cannot open some of the saved content. Copy the JSON if you need it, or start over. The original stays in recovery storage.";
    case "future-version":
      return `This document uses schema version ${String(result.schemaVersion)}. This editor reads version ${String(EDITOR_SCHEMA_VERSION)}. Copy the JSON if you need it, or start over. The original stays in recovery storage.`;
  }
}

function rawJson(raw: unknown): string {
  if (typeof raw === "string") {
    return raw;
  }

  try {
    const text = JSON.stringify(raw, null, 2);
    if (typeof text === "string") {
      return text;
    }
  } catch {
    return "";
  }

  return "";
}

export function EditorRecoveryNotice({
  result,
  raw,
  error,
  onStartOver,
}: EditorRecoveryNoticeProps) {
  const text = rawJson(raw);
  const issues = result.status === "future-version" ? [] : result.issues;
  const shown = issues.slice(0, 5);
  const extra = issues.length - shown.length;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[var(--editor-max-width,700px)] min-w-0 py-8 sm:py-12">
      <Alert className="min-w-0">
        <AlertTitle>{titleFor(result)}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>
          <p>{detailFor(result)}</p>
          {shown.length > 0 ? (
            <ul className="mt-3 list-disc pl-5">
              {shown.map((issue, index) => (
                <li key={`${issue.path.join(".")}-${String(index)}`}>{issue.message}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : null}
          {extra > 0 ? <p className="mt-2">{`${String(extra)} more.`}</p> : null}
        </AlertDescription>
        <ScrollFadeArea
          orientation="vertical"
          className="border-border bg-muted text-foreground mt-3 max-h-60 w-full max-w-full min-w-0 rounded-md border"
        >
          <pre
            tabIndex={0}
            aria-label="Document JSON"
            className="w-full p-3 font-mono text-sm [overflow-wrap:anywhere] whitespace-pre-wrap"
          >
            {text}
          </pre>
        </ScrollFadeArea>
        {error ? (
          <p role="alert" className="text-destructive mt-3 text-sm text-pretty">
            {error}
          </p>
        ) : null}
        <TooltipProvider>
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Tooltip>
              <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                <CopyButton text={text} variant="outline" size="icon" aria-label="Copy JSON" />
              </TooltipTrigger>
              <TooltipContent>Copy JSON</TooltipContent>
            </Tooltip>
            <EditorTextButton
              variant="outline"
              label="Start over"
              icon={<RotateCcw aria-hidden="true" />}
              onClick={onStartOver}
            />
          </div>
        </TooltipProvider>
      </Alert>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/editor/ready-editor.tsx
```tsx
"use client";
```

```tsx
import { EditorSaveStatus } from "./editor-save-status";
import { EditorSurface } from "./editor-surface";
import type { AutosaveStatus } from "../../lib/document/editor-autosave";
import type { LinkPreviewAdapter } from "../../lib/features/editor-bookmark-url";
import type { FileUploadAdapter } from "../../lib/features/editor-file-upload";
import type { MentionProvider } from "../../lib/features/editor-mention-node";
import type { PageOpenRequest, PageProvider } from "../../lib/features/editor-page-link";
import type { EditorValue } from "../../lib/document/editor-value";
import { useNotionLikeEditor } from "../../hooks/use-notion-like-editor";

type ReadyEditorProps = {
  documentId: string;
  initialValue: EditorValue;
  readOnly: boolean;
  placeholder: string;
  ariaLabel: string;
  onChange?: (value: EditorValue) => void;
  onContentChange: (value: EditorValue) => void;
  status: AutosaveStatus;
  message?: string;
  onRetry: () => void;
  linkPreview?: LinkPreviewAdapter | null;
  mentionProvider?: MentionProvider | null;
  pageProvider?: PageProvider | null;
  onOpenPage?: (request: PageOpenRequest) => void;
  fileUpload?: FileUploadAdapter | null;
};

export function ReadyEditor({
  documentId,
  initialValue,
  readOnly,
  placeholder,
  ariaLabel,
  onChange,
  onContentChange,
  status,
  message,
  onRetry,
  linkPreview = null,
  mentionProvider = null,
  pageProvider = null,
  onOpenPage,
  fileUpload = null,
}: ReadyEditorProps) {
  const { editor } = useNotionLikeEditor({ documentId, initialValue });
  // The healthy states render nothing, so the row takes no space. Only the
  // failure notice appears, and it is the only thing above the editor.
  const showNotice = status === "error" || status === "conflict";

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex h-full min-h-full w-full max-w-[var(--editor-max-width,700px)] min-w-0 flex-col">
      {showNotice ? (
        <div className="flex justify-end pt-4">
          <EditorSaveStatus status={status} message={message} onRetry={onRetry} />
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <EditorSurface
        editor={editor}
        readOnly={readOnly}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        ariaLabel={ariaLabel}
        onValueChange={(value) => {
          onChange?.(value);
          onContentChange(value);
        }}
        linkPreview={linkPreview}
        mentionProvider={mentionProvider}
        pageProvider={pageProvider}
        onOpenPage={onOpenPage}
        fileUpload={fileUpload}
        className="text-foreground caret-foreground min-h-full w-full min-w-0 py-8 text-base leading-relaxed wrap-break-word outline-none sm:py-12"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/editor/persisted-editor.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { EditorDocumentSkeleton } from "./editor-document-skeleton";
import { EditorRecoveryNotice } from "./editor-recovery-notice";
import type { EditorPersistenceAdapter } from "../../lib/document/editor-persistence";
import { DEFAULT_PLACEHOLDER } from "../../lib/features/editor-placeholder";
import type { NotionLikeEditorBlockProps } from "../../notion-like-editor-block";
import { ReadyEditor } from "./ready-editor";
import { useEditorDocument } from "../../hooks/use-editor-document";

export function PersistedEditor({
  documentId,
  initialValue,
  onChange,
  readOnly = false,
  placeholder = DEFAULT_PLACEHOLDER,
  ariaLabel = "Rich text editor",
  className,
  adapter,
  linkPreview = null,
  mentionProvider = null,
  pageProvider = null,
  onOpenPage,
  fileUpload = null,
}: NotionLikeEditorBlockProps & { adapter: EditorPersistenceAdapter }) {
  const session = useEditorDocument({ documentId, adapter, readOnly, initialValue });

  return (
    <div className={cn("bg-background h-full min-h-full w-full min-w-0 px-4", className)}>
      {session.phase === "loading" ? <EditorDocumentSkeleton /> : null}
      {session.phase === "recovery" ? (
        <EditorRecoveryNotice
          result={session.result}
          raw={session.raw}
          error={session.error}
          onStartOver={() => {
            void session.startOver();
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
      {session.phase === "ready" ? (
        <ReadyEditor
          documentId={documentId}
          initialValue={session.document.content}
          readOnly={readOnly}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          ariaLabel={ariaLabel}
          onChange={onChange}
          onContentChange={session.onContentChange}
          linkPreview={linkPreview}
          mentionProvider={mentionProvider}
          pageProvider={pageProvider}
          onOpenPage={onOpenPage}
          fileUpload={fileUpload}
          status={session.status}
          message={session.message}
          onRetry={() => {
            void session.retry();
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/notion-like-editor-block.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import type { LinkPreviewAdapter } from "./lib/features/editor-bookmark-url";
import type { FileUploadAdapter } from "./lib/features/editor-file-upload";
import type { MentionProvider } from "./lib/features/editor-mention-node";
import type { PageOpenRequest, PageProvider } from "./lib/features/editor-page-link";
import type { EditorPersistenceAdapter } from "./lib/document/editor-persistence";
import type { EditorValue } from "./lib/document/editor-value";
import { MemoryEditor } from "./components/editor/memory-editor";
import { PersistedEditor } from "./components/editor/persisted-editor";

export type NotionLikeEditorBlockProps = {
  documentId: string;
  initialValue?: EditorValue;
  onChange?: (value: EditorValue) => void;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
  adapter?: EditorPersistenceAdapter;
  linkPreview?: LinkPreviewAdapter | null;
  mentionProvider?: MentionProvider | null;
  pageProvider?: PageProvider | null;
  onOpenPage?: (request: PageOpenRequest) => void;
  fileUpload?: FileUploadAdapter | null;
};

export function NotionLikeEditorBlock(props: NotionLikeEditorBlockProps) {
  if (props.adapter) {
    return <PersistedEditor key={props.documentId} {...props} adapter={props.adapter} />;
  }

  return <MemoryEditor {...props} />;
}
```

```ts
// The id is the content. A changed demo gets a new storage key, so an older
// edit cannot hide the current showcase. Edits to this content keep this id.
function fnv1a(text: string): string {
  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {
    hash ^= text.charCodeAt(index);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193);
  }

  return (hash >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

export function demoDocumentId(value: EditorValue): string {
  return `demo-${fnv1a(JSON.stringify(value))}`;
}

export const DEMO_DOCUMENT_ID = demoDocumentId(DEMO_DOCUMENT_VALUE);
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/demo/demo-link-preview.ts
```ts
import type { LinkPreview, LinkPreviewAdapter } from "../lib/features/editor-bookmark-url";

const DEMO_PREVIEW_DELAY_MS = 400;

const FIXTURES: Record<string, LinkPreview> = {
  "https://platejs.org/docs": {
    title: "Plate",
    description: "The rich-text editor framework for React.",
    siteName: "Plate",
    imageUrl: "/blocks/notion-like-editor/bookmark-demo.svg",
  },
  "https://github.com/udecode/plate": {
    title: "udecode/plate",
    description: "The rich-text editor framework for React.",
    siteName: "GitHub",
    imageUrl: "/blocks/notion-like-editor/bookmark-demo.svg",
  },
};

export const demoLinkPreviewAdapter: LinkPreviewAdapter = {
  fetchPreview(url, signal) {
    return wait(DEMO_PREVIEW_DELAY_MS, signal).then(() => fixtureFor(url));
  },
};

function fixtureFor(url: string): LinkPreview | null {
  return FIXTURES[url] ?? null;
}

function wait(ms: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (signal.aborted) {
      reject(abortError());
      return;
    }

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
      resolve();
    }, ms);
    const onAbort = (): void => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      reject(abortError());
    };
    signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
  });
}

function abortError(): Error {
  const error = new Error("The operation was aborted.");
  error.name = "AbortError";
  return error;
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/demo/demo-mention.ts
```ts
import type { MentionEntity, MentionProvider } from "../lib/features/editor-mention-node";

const DEMO_PEOPLE: readonly MentionEntity[] = [
  {
    entityType: "person",
    entityId: "person-alex-kim",
    label: "Alex Kim",
    email: "alex.kim@example.com",
  },
  {
    entityType: "person",
    entityId: "person-alex-kim-2",
    label: "Alex Kim",
    email: "alex.kim.studio@example.com",
  },
  {
    entityType: "person",
    entityId: "person-ngo-gia",
    label: "Ngô Gia",
    email: "gia@example.com",
  },
  {
    entityType: "person",
    entityId: "person-tran-mai",
    label: "Trần Mai",
    email: "mai@example.com",
  },
  {
    entityType: "person",
    entityId: "person-lena-ortiz",
    label: "Lena Ortiz",
    email: "lena@example.com",
  },
  {
    entityType: "person",
    entityId: "person-minh-pham",
    label: "Minh Phạm",
    email: "minh@example.com",
  },
];

function fold(value: string): string {
  return value.normalize("NFD").replace(/\p{M}/gu, "").toLocaleLowerCase("en");
}

function abortError(): Error {
  const error = new Error("The mention search was aborted.");
  error.name = "AbortError";
  return error;
}

function matches(person: MentionEntity, query: string): boolean {
  if (query.length === 0) {
    return true;
  }

  const label = fold(person.label);
  const email = fold(person.email ?? "");
  return label.includes(query) || email.includes(query);
}

export const demoMentionProvider: MentionProvider = {
  search(query, signal) {
    if (signal.aborted) {
      return Promise.reject(abortError());
    }

    const folded = fold(query.trim());
    return Promise.resolve(DEMO_PEOPLE.filter((person) => matches(person, folded)));
  },
  resolve(entityType, entityId, signal) {
    if (signal.aborted) {
      return Promise.reject(abortError());
    }

    const found = DEMO_PEOPLE.find(
      (person) => person.entityType === entityType && person.entityId === entityId,
    );
    return Promise.resolve(found ?? null);
  },
};
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/features/editor-toc-outline.ts
```ts
import { ElementApi, KEYS, NodeApi, type Descendant, type TElement } from "platejs";

export const TOC_DEPTHS = [1, 2, 3] as const;
export type TocDepth = (typeof TOC_DEPTHS)[number];
export const TOC_DEFAULT_DEPTH: TocDepth = 3;
export const TOC_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER = "Add headings to build a table of contents.";
export const TOC_UNTITLED = "Untitled";

export type TocEntry = {
  id: string;
  depth: TocDepth;
  title: string;
  path: number[];
};

export function isTocDepth(value: unknown): value is TocDepth {
  return value === 1 || value === 2 || value === 3;
}

export function storedTocDepth(node: TElement): TocDepth {
  return isTocDepth(node.maxDepth) ? node.maxDepth : TOC_DEFAULT_DEPTH;
}

export function headingPlainText(node: TElement): string {
  return NodeApi.string(node).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function headingDepth(type: string): TocDepth | undefined {
  if (type === KEYS.h1) return 1;
  if (type === KEYS.h2) return 2;
  if (type === KEYS.h3) return 3;
  return undefined;
}

export function tocEntriesFromValue(value: readonly Descendant[], maxDepth: TocDepth): TocEntry[] {
  const entries: TocEntry[] = [];
  const visit = (node: Descendant, path: number[]): void => {
    if (!ElementApi.isElement(node) || typeof node.type !== "string") {
      return;
    }
    const depth = headingDepth(node.type);
    if (
      depth !== undefined &&
      depth <= maxDepth &&
      typeof node.id === "string" &&
      node.id.length > 0
    ) {
      entries.push({
        id: node.id,
        depth,
        title: headingPlainText(node),
        path: [...path],
      });
    }
    node.children.forEach((child, index) => {
      visit(child, path.concat(index));
    });
  };
  value.forEach((node, index) => {
    visit(node, [index]);
  });
  return entries;
}

export function shallowestDepth(entries: readonly { depth: TocDepth }[]): TocDepth {
  let shallowest: TocDepth = TOC_DEFAULT_DEPTH;
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (entry.depth < shallowest) {
      shallowest = entry.depth;
    }
  }
  return shallowest;
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/lib/static/read-static-value.ts
```ts
import { createEditorDocument } from "../document/editor-document";
import { migrateEditorDocument } from "../document/editor-document-migrate";
import {
  EDITOR_ELEMENT_RULES,
  isAllowedElementAttrValue,
} from "../document/editor-document-schema";
import { isMediaBlockType } from "../features/editor-media-source";
import { sanitizeLinkUrl } from "../features/editor-link-url";
import { parseEditorDocument } from "../document/editor-document-validate";
import type { EditorValue } from "../document/editor-value";

const KNOWN_TYPES = new Set<string>(EDITOR_ELEMENT_RULES.map((rule) => rule.type));

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function plainText(value: unknown): string {
  if (!isRecord(value)) {
    return "";
  }
  if (typeof value.text === "string" && !("children" in value)) {
    return value.text;
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(value.children)) {
    return "";
  }
  return value.children.map((child) => plainText(child)).join("");
}

// An unknown type still shows its text. Known nodes keep their children.
function softenNode(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  if (!isRecord(value)) {
    return null;
  }
  if (typeof value.text === "string" && !("type" in value)) {
    return value;
  }
  const type = typeof value.type === "string" ? value.type : "";
  const children = Array.isArray(value.children)
    ? value.children.map((child) => softenNode(child) ?? { text: "" })
    : [{ text: plainText(value) }];
  if (type.length === 0 || !KNOWN_TYPES.has(type)) {
    return {
      type: "p",
      id: typeof value.id === "string" ? value.id : undefined,
      children: [{ text: plainText(value) }],
    };
  }
  const next: Record<string, unknown> = { ...value, children };
  for (const key of Object.keys(next)) {
    if (key === "type" || key === "children") continue;
    if (
      key === "url" &&
      typeof next.url === "string" &&
      sanitizeLinkUrl(next.url) === undefined &&
      type !== "bookmark" &&
      !isMediaBlockType(type)
    ) {
      delete next.url;
    }
    if (
      !isAllowedElementAttrValue(
        type as Parameters<typeof isAllowedElementAttrValue>[0],
        key,
        next[key],
      ) &&
      key !== "url" &&
      key !== "texExpression" &&
      key !== "targetBlockId" &&
      key !== "width" &&
      key !== "colSizes"
    ) {
      delete next[key];
    }
  }
  return next;
}

function soften(content: EditorValue): EditorValue {
  return content.map(
    (node) => softenNode(node) ?? { type: "p", children: [{ text: "" }] },
  ) as EditorValue;
}

/**
 * The editor loads through migrateEditorDocument then parseEditorDocument.
 * A future version, a non-document, or a value that cannot be read renders nothing.
 * Unsupported nodes stay visible as paragraphs instead of throwing.
 */
export function readStaticValue(value: unknown): EditorValue | null {
  try {
    if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
      return null;
    }
    const migrated = migrateEditorDocument(
      createEditorDocument("static", value as EditorValue),
      "static",
    );
    const parsed = parseEditorDocument(migrated);
    if (parsed.status === "ok") {
      return soften(parsed.document.content);
    }
    if (parsed.status === "unsupported") {
      return soften(value as EditorValue);
    }
    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

```ts
function tokenProps(
  nodeKey: string,
  cssProperty: "color" | "backgroundColor" | "fontFamily",
  variablePrefix: "--editor-text" | "--editor-bg" | "--editor-font",
  isToken: (value: unknown) => boolean,
) {
  return {
    nodeKey,
    transformProps: ({
      nodeValue,
      props,
    }: {
      nodeValue?: unknown;
      props: Record<string, unknown>;
    }) => {
      if (!isToken(nodeValue)) {
        return {};
      }
      return { ...props, style: { [cssProperty]: `var(${variablePrefix}-${String(nodeValue)})` } };
    },
  };
}

// Same rule as the editor: a code leaf is always mono, and inline style beats the code class.
function fontFamilyNodeProps() {
  const fontFamily = tokenProps(KEYS.fontFamily, "fontFamily", "--editor-font", (value) =>
    isAllowedValue(value, FONT_FAMILIES),
  );

  return {
    nodeKey: fontFamily.nodeKey,
    transformProps: (options: {
      nodeValue?: unknown;
      props: Record<string, unknown>;
      text?: unknown;
    }) => {
      if (isAllowedValue(options.nodeValue, FONT_FAMILIES) && hasCodeMark(options.text)) {
        return { ...options.props, style: { fontFamily: "var(--editor-font-mono)" } };
      }

      return fontFamily.transformProps(options);
    },
  };
}

function hasCodeMark(text: unknown): boolean {
  return (
    typeof text === "object" &&
    text !== null &&
    KEYS.code in text &&
    Reflect.get(text, KEYS.code) === true
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/static/code-highlight.ts
```ts
import bash from "highlight.js/lib/languages/bash";
import css from "highlight.js/lib/languages/css";
import diff from "highlight.js/lib/languages/diff";
import go from "highlight.js/lib/languages/go";
import javascript from "highlight.js/lib/languages/javascript";
import json from "highlight.js/lib/languages/json";
import markdown from "highlight.js/lib/languages/markdown";
import python from "highlight.js/lib/languages/python";
import rust from "highlight.js/lib/languages/rust";
import sql from "highlight.js/lib/languages/sql";
import typescript from "highlight.js/lib/languages/typescript";
import xml from "highlight.js/lib/languages/xml";
import yaml from "highlight.js/lib/languages/yaml";
type HastNode = {
  type: string;
  value?: string;
  children?: HastNode[];
  properties?: { className?: string | string[] };
};

import { codeLowlight } from "../../lib/features/editor-code";
import { CODE_LANGS, type CodeLang } from "../../lib/document/editor-document-schema";

const GRAMMARS = {
  typescript,
  tsx: typescript,
  javascript,
  jsx: javascript,
  json,
  html: xml,
  css,
  bash,
  python,
  go,
  rust,
  sql,
  markdown,
  yaml,
  diff,
} as const satisfies Record<CodeLang, typeof typescript>;

let registered = false;

// The editor loads these grammars on demand. A server render cannot await that,
// so the same codeLowlight instance receives the same grammars up front.
export function ensureStaticCodeLanguages(): void {
  if (registered) {
    return;
  }
  registered = true;
  for (const lang of CODE_LANGS) {
    if (!codeLowlight.registered(lang)) {
      codeLowlight.register(lang, GRAMMARS[lang]);
    }
  }
}

export type HighlightSpan = { text: string; className?: string };

function classNameOf(node: HastNode): string | undefined {
  if (node.type !== "element") {
    return undefined;
  }
  const value = node.properties?.className;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.join(" ");
  }
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : undefined;
}

function walk(node: HastNode, className: string | undefined, spans: HighlightSpan[]): void {
  if (node.type === "text") {
    spans.push({ text: node.value ?? "", className });
    return;
  }
  if (node.type !== "element") {
    return;
  }
  const next = classNameOf(node) ?? className;
  for (const child of node.children ?? []) {
    walk(child, next, spans);
  }
}

export function highlightCode(lang: string | null, text: string): HighlightSpan[] {
  ensureStaticCodeLanguages();
  const language = lang !== null && codeLowlight.registered(lang) ? lang : "plaintext";
  const tree = codeLowlight.highlight(language, text) as { children: HastNode[] };
  const spans: HighlightSpan[] = [];
  for (const child of tree.children) {
    walk(child, undefined, spans);
  }
  if (spans.length === 0) {
    spans.push({ text });
  }
  return spans;
}
```

```tsx
import { SlateElement, type SlateElementProps } from "platejs/static";

import { HEADING_STYLES, headingAnchorId, type HeadingTag } from "../elements/heading-styles";

function headingTag(type: string): HeadingTag {
  if (type === "h1" || type === "h2" || type === "h3") {
    return type;
  }
  return "h1";
}

export function HeadingStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const tag = headingTag(props.element.type);
  const id = typeof props.element.id === "string" ? props.element.id : "";
  return (
    <SlateElement
      {...props}
      as={tag}
      className={HEADING_STYLES[tag]}
      attributes={{
        ...props.attributes,
        id: id.length > 0 ? headingAnchorId(id) : undefined,
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/static/list-static.tsx
```tsx
import { isOrderedList } from "@platejs/list";
import { KEYS } from "platejs";
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import { type ReactNode } from "react";
import { SlateElement, type SlateElementProps } from "platejs/static";

import { LIST_INDENTS, type ListIndent } from "../../lib/document/editor-document-schema";
import { todoTextId } from "../elements/block-list-metrics";

const MARKER_CYCLE = {
  disc: ["disc", "circle", "square"],
  decimal: ["decimal", "lower-alpha", "lower-roman"],
} as const;

const LIST_INDENT_CLASS = {
  disc: { 1: "pl-6", 2: "pl-12", 3: "pl-18", 4: "pl-24", 5: "pl-30", 6: "pl-36" },
  decimal: { 1: "pl-10", 2: "pl-16", 3: "pl-22", 4: "pl-28", 5: "pl-34", 6: "pl-40" },
} as const;

type MarkerStyle = keyof typeof MARKER_CYCLE;

function listMarker(style: MarkerStyle, indent: number): string {
  const cycle = MARKER_CYCLE[style];
  const level = indent >= 1 ? indent : 1;
  return cycle[(level - 1) % cycle.length] ?? cycle[0];
}

function indentClass(style: string, indent: number): string {
  const classes = style === "decimal" ? LIST_INDENT_CLASS.decimal : LIST_INDENT_CLASS.disc;
  const level = LIST_INDENTS.find((item) => item === indent);
  return level === undefined ? classes[1] : classes[level as ListIndent];
}

const CHECKBOX_CLASS =
  "border-input relative flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[4px] border data-checked:border-primary data-checked:bg-primary data-checked:text-primary-foreground";

function TodoBox({ checked }: { checked: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span className="absolute top-1 -left-5 flex">
      <span
        role="checkbox"
        aria-checked={checked}
        aria-disabled="true"
        data-checked={checked ? "" : undefined}
        className={`${CHECKBOX_CLASS} pointer-events-none`}
      >
        {checked ? <Check aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5" /> : null}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

export function ListParagraphStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const listStyleType = props.element.listStyleType;
  const attributes =
    typeof listStyleType === "string"
      ? { ...props.attributes, "data-list-item": listStyleType }
      : props.attributes;
  return <SlateElement {...props} attributes={attributes} />;
}

export function listBelowNodes(props: { element: SlateElementProps["element"] }) {
  if (typeof props.element.listStyleType !== "string") {
    return;
  }

  return function List(nodeProps: { children?: ReactNode; element: SlateElementProps["element"] }) {
    const element = nodeProps.element;
    const stored = typeof element.listStyleType === "string" ? element.listStyleType : "disc";
    const indent = typeof element.indent === "number" ? element.indent : 1;
    if (stored === KEYS.listTodo) {
      const checked = element.checked === true;
      const blockId = typeof element.id === "string" ? element.id : "";
      return (
        <ul className={`relative m-0 list-none py-0 pr-0 ${indentClass(stored, indent)}`}>
          <li className="relative">
            <TodoBox checked={checked} />
            <span
              id={blockId.length > 0 ? todoTextId(blockId) : undefined}
              data-checked={checked ? "" : undefined}
              className="data-checked:text-muted-foreground data-checked:line-through"
            >
              {nodeProps.children}
            </span>
          </li>
        </ul>
      );
    }

    const ordered = isOrderedList(element);
    const Tag = ordered ? "ol" : "ul";
    const marker = stored === "disc" || stored === "decimal" ? listMarker(stored, indent) : stored;
    const listStart = element.listStart;
    return (
      <Tag
        className={`relative m-0 list-outside py-0 pr-0 ${indentClass(stored, indent)}`}
        style={{ listStyleType: marker }}
        start={ordered && typeof listStart === "number" ? listStart : undefined}
      >
        <li>{nodeProps.children}</li>
      </Tag>
    );
  };
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/static/toggle-static.tsx
```tsx
import { Children, createElement, type ReactElement, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { SlateElement, type SlateElementProps } from "platejs/static";

import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { TOGGLE_CLASS_NAME } from "../elements/toggle-classes";

function isElement(value: unknown): value is ReactElement<{ children?: unknown }> {
  const record = value as { $$typeof?: unknown } | null;
  return Boolean(record && typeof record === "object" && "$$typeof" in record);
}

function withChildren(element: ReactElement<{ children?: unknown }>, children: unknown): ReactNode {
  const { children: _ignored, ...rest } = element.props;
  return createElement(element.type, rest, children as ReactNode);
}

function split(children: ReactNode): { label: ReactNode; content: ReactNode } {
  const nodes = Children.toArray(children);
  const only = nodes[0];
  if (nodes.length !== 1 || !isElement(only)) {
    return { label: nodes[0] ?? children, content: nodes.slice(1) };
  }

  const slateChildren = only.props.children;
  if (!Array.isArray(slateChildren) || slateChildren.length <= 1) {
    return { label: only, content: null };
  }

  return {
    label: withChildren(only, [slateChildren[0]]),
    content: withChildren(only, slateChildren.slice(1)),
  };
}

export function ToggleStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const { label, content } = split(props.children);
  return (
    <SlateElement {...props} className={TOGGLE_CLASS_NAME}>
      <details className="space-y-2 [&>:not(summary)]:pl-9">
        <summary className="flex list-none items-center gap-1 [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">
          <div className="shrink-0">
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className={cn(
                buttonVariants({ variant: "ghost", size: "icon" }),
                "pointer-events-none",
              )}
            >
              <ChevronRight
                aria-hidden="true"
                className="size-4 transition-transform duration-150 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none [details[open]_&]:rotate-90"
              />
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">{label}</div>
        </summary>
        {content}
      </details>
    </SlateElement>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/static/code-block-static.tsx
```tsx
import {
  SlateElement,
  SlateLeaf,
  type SlateElementProps,
  type SlateLeafProps,
} from "platejs/static";

import {
  CODE_LANGS,
  CODE_LANG_LABELS,
  type CodeLang,
} from "../../lib/document/editor-document-schema";
import {
  CODE_BLOCK_CLASS_NAME,
  CODE_SCROLL_CLASS_NAME,
  CODE_TOOLBAR_CLASS_NAME,
} from "../elements/code-block-classes";

function elementLang(element: SlateElementProps["element"]): CodeLang | null {
  const stored = CODE_LANGS.find((lang) => lang === element.lang);
  return stored ?? null;
}

function languageLabel(lang: CodeLang | null): string {
  return lang === null ? CODE_LANG_LABELS.plaintext : CODE_LANG_LABELS[lang];
}

export function CodeBlockStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const lang = elementLang(props.element);
  return (
    <SlateElement {...props} as="pre" className={CODE_BLOCK_CLASS_NAME}>
      <div className={CODE_TOOLBAR_CLASS_NAME}>
        <span className="text-muted-foreground px-1.5 py-1 text-xs">{languageLabel(lang)}</span>
      </div>
      <code className={CODE_SCROLL_CLASS_NAME}>{props.children}</code>
    </SlateElement>
  );
}

export function CodeLineStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  return <SlateElement {...props} as="div" />;
}

export function CodeSyntaxStatic(props: SlateLeafProps) {
  const className = typeof props.leaf.className === "string" ? props.leaf.className : undefined;
  return <SlateLeaf {...props} className={className} />;
}
```

```tsx
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { KEYS, type TElement } from "platejs";
import { SlateElement, type SlateElementProps } from "platejs/static";

import { isPaletteToken, TEXT_ALIGNS } from "../../lib/document/editor-document-schema";

const CELL_BORDER_CLASS = "min-w-12 border-r border-b border-border";
const ROW_CLASS =
  "hover:bg-muted/50 border-b border-0 bg-transparent transition-colors hover:bg-transparent data-[state=selected]:bg-transparent";
const HEAD_CLASS = "text-foreground h-10 px-2 text-left align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap";
const CELL_CLASS = "p-2 align-middle whitespace-nowrap";

function spanOf(value: unknown): number | undefined {
  return typeof value === "number" && value > 1 ? value : undefined;
}

function cellStyle(element: TElement): CSSProperties | undefined {
  const style: React.CSSProperties = {};
  if (typeof element.align === "string" && TEXT_ALIGNS.some((item) => item === element.align)) {
    style.textAlign = element.align as CSSProperties["textAlign"];
  }
  if (isPaletteToken(element.background)) {
    style.backgroundColor = `var(--editor-bg-${element.background})`;
  }
  return Object.keys(style).length > 0 ? style : undefined;
}

export function TableStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const sizes = Array.isArray(props.element.colSizes) ? props.element.colSizes : [];
  const width = sizes.reduce<number>(
    (total, size) => total + (typeof size === "number" ? size : 0),
    0,
  );
  const tableWidth = width > 0 ? width : undefined;
  return (
    <SlateElement
      {...props}
      className="group [&_[data-slot=table-container]]:scroll-fade-x relative my-2 max-w-full"
    >
      <div data-slot="table-container" className="scroll-fade-x relative w-full">
        <table
          data-slot="table"
          className="w-full caption-bottom border-separate border-spacing-0 text-sm"
          style={
            tableWidth === undefined
              ? undefined
              : { width: tableWidth, minWidth: tableWidth, borderCollapse: "separate" }
          }
        >
          {sizes.length > 0 ? (
            <colgroup>
              {sizes.map((size, index) => (
                <col key={index} style={typeof size === "number" ? { width: size } : undefined} />
              ))}
            </colgroup>
          ) : null}
          <tbody data-slot="table-body">{props.children}</tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </SlateElement>
  );
}

function structuralElement(element: TElement): TElement {
  if (typeof element.id !== "string") {
    return element;
  }
  const { id: _id, ...rest } = element;
  return rest as TElement;
}

export function TableRowStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  return (
    <SlateElement
      {...props}
      element={structuralElement(props.element)}
      as="tr"
      className={ROW_CLASS}
    />
  );
}

export function TableCellStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const header = props.element.type === KEYS.th;
  const column = props.path.at(-1) ?? 0;
  const row = props.path.at(-2) ?? 0;
  const edge = `${column === 0 ? "border-l" : ""} ${row === 0 ? "border-t" : ""}`;
  return (
    <SlateElement
      {...props}
      element={structuralElement(props.element)}
      as={header ? "th" : "td"}
      className={`${header ? HEAD_CLASS : CELL_CLASS} ${CELL_BORDER_CLASS} ${edge}`}
      style={cellStyle(props.element)}
      attributes={{
        ...props.attributes,
        colSpan: spanOf(props.element.colSpan),
        rowSpan: spanOf(props.element.rowSpan),
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { KEYS, type TElement } from "platejs";
import { SlateElement, type SlateElementProps } from "platejs/static";

import { COLUMN_GROUP_LAYOUT_CLASS } from "../elements/column-classes";

function widths(element: TElement): string[] {
  return element.children.flatMap((child) => {
    if (
      typeof child !== "object" ||
      child === null ||
      !("type" in child) ||
      child.type !== KEYS.column
    ) {
      return [];
    }
    return [typeof child.width === "string" ? child.width : "1fr"];
  });
}

export function ColumnStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  return (
    <SlateElement {...props} className="min-w-0">
      <div className="min-w-0">{props.children}</div>
    </SlateElement>
  );
}

export function ColumnGroupStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const template = widths(props.element)
    .map((width) => {
      const parsed = Number.parseFloat(width);
      return `${Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 1}fr`;
    })
    .join(" ");
  return (
    <SlateElement {...props} className="relative my-2">
      <div
        data-column-layout="stack"
        className={COLUMN_GROUP_LAYOUT_CLASS}
        style={{ "--column-widths": template } as CSSProperties}
      >
        {props.children}
      </div>
    </SlateElement>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { storedBookmark } from "../../lib/features/editor-bookmark-url";
```

```tsx
import { SlateElement, type SlateElementProps } from "platejs/static";

import { isExternalLinkUrl, sanitizeLinkUrl } from "../../lib/features/editor-link-url";

export function LinkStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const url = typeof props.element.url === "string" ? props.element.url : "";
  const safe = sanitizeLinkUrl(url);
  if (safe === undefined) {
    return <span {...props.attributes}>{props.children}</span>;
  }
  const external = isExternalLinkUrl(safe);
  return (
    <SlateElement
      {...props}
      as="a"
      className="link-underline"
      attributes={{
        ...props.attributes,
        href: safe,
        target: external ? "_blank" : undefined,
        rel: external ? "noopener noreferrer nofollow" : undefined,
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/static/toc-static.tsx
```tsx
import { SlateElement, type SlateElementProps } from "platejs/static";

import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { headingAnchorId } from "../elements/heading-styles";
import {
  TOC_UNTITLED,
  shallowestDepth,
  storedTocDepth,
  tocEntriesFromValue,
} from "../../lib/features/editor-toc-outline";

const TOC_INDENT_CLASS = ["ps-0", "ps-4", "ps-8"] as const;

function indentClass(level: number): string {
  if (level === 1) return TOC_INDENT_CLASS[1];
  if (level >= 2) return TOC_INDENT_CLASS[2];
  return TOC_INDENT_CLASS[0];
}

export function TocStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const depth = storedTocDepth(props.element);
  const entries = tocEntriesFromValue(props.editor.children, depth);
  const shallowest = shallowestDepth(entries);
  return (
    <SlateElement {...props} className="group relative my-2 rounded-md">
      {entries.length === 0 ? null : (
        <nav aria-label="Table of contents" data-toc-depth={depth}>
          <ol className="m-0 list-none space-y-1 p-0">
            {entries.map((entry) => {
              const untitled = entry.title.length === 0;
              const label = untitled ? TOC_UNTITLED : entry.title;
              return (
                <li key={entry.id} className={indentClass(entry.depth - shallowest)}>
                  <a
                    href={`#${headingAnchorId(entry.id)}`}
                    data-slot="button"
                    data-variant="ghost"
                    data-size="sm"
                    data-toc-target={entry.id}
                    data-toc-indent={entry.depth - shallowest}
                    data-toc-untitled={untitled ? "true" : undefined}
                    className={cn(
                      buttonVariants({ variant: "ghost", size: "sm" }),
                      "h-auto w-full justify-start px-1 whitespace-normal",
                      untitled && "text-muted-foreground",
                    )}
                  >
                    {label}
                  </a>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        </nav>
      )}
      {props.children}
    </SlateElement>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/static/equation-static.tsx
```tsx
import katex from "katex";
import { SlateElement, type SlateElementProps } from "platejs/static";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import {
  EQUATION_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER,
  renderEquation,
} from "../../lib/features/editor-equation-render";
import { EQUATION_BLOCK_CLASS } from "../elements/equation-classes";

import "katex/dist/katex.min.css";

export function EquationStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const expression =
    typeof props.element.texExpression === "string" ? props.element.texExpression : "";
  let body: ReactNode;
  if (expression.length === 0) {
    body = (
      <p data-equation-empty className="text-muted-foreground text-center text-sm">
        {EQUATION_EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER}
      </p>
    );
  } else {
    const rendered = renderEquation(katex, expression);
    body = rendered.ok ? (
      <div
        data-equation-math
        className="text-foreground"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: rendered.html }}
      />
    ) : (
      <div data-equation-error className="max-w-full min-w-0">
        <p className="text-destructive/70 text-sm">{rendered.message}</p>
        <pre className="font-mono text-sm whitespace-pre">{expression}</pre>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SlateElement {...props} className={EQUATION_BLOCK_CLASS}>
      <div className="max-w-full min-w-0">
        <div data-equation-scroll className="scroll-fade-x relative max-w-full min-w-0">
          <div className="flex w-max min-w-full justify-center">{body}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {props.children}
    </SlateElement>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { SlateElement, type SlateElementProps } from "platejs/static";

import { footnoteIndex, footnoteReferenceOrdinal } from "../../lib/features/editor-footnote-index";
import { footnoteRefClassName } from "../elements/footnote-classes";

// Static markup only. The number and the ordinal come from the same document the element sits in.
export function FootnoteRefStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const footnoteId = typeof props.element.footnoteId === "string" ? props.element.footnoteId : "";
  const index = footnoteIndex(props.editor);
  const number = index.numbers.get(footnoteId);
  const className = footnoteRefClassName(false);

  return (
    <SlateElement {...props} as="span" className="inline align-baseline">
      {index.definitions.has(footnoteId) && number !== undefined ? (
        <sup
          data-footnote-ref=""
          data-footnote-id={footnoteId}
          id={`fnref-${footnoteId}-${footnoteReferenceOrdinal(props.editor.children, footnoteId, props.element.id)}`}
          aria-label={`Footnote ${number}`}
          className={className}
        >
          <a href={`#fn-${footnoteId}`}>{number}</a>
        </sup>
      ) : (
        <sup
          data-footnote-ref=""
          data-footnote-id={footnoteId}
          data-footnote-missing=""
          aria-label="Footnote not found"
          className={className}
        >
          ?
        </sup>
      )}
      {props.children}
    </SlateElement>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/static/footnote-def-static.tsx
```tsx
import { SlateElement, type SlateElementProps } from "platejs/static";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { footnoteIndex, startsFootnoteRun } from "../../lib/features/editor-footnote-index";
import {
  FOOTNOTE_DEF_CLASS,
  FOOTNOTE_DEF_RUN_CLASS,
  FOOTNOTE_NUMBER_CLASS,
  FOOTNOTE_NUMBER_LINK_CLASS,
  FOOTNOTE_TEXT_CLASS,
} from "../elements/footnote-classes";

// Static markup only. The back link appears only when some reference points here.
export function FootnoteDefStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const footnoteId = typeof props.element.footnoteId === "string" ? props.element.footnoteId : "";
  const number = footnoteIndex(props.editor).numbers.get(footnoteId);
  const referenced = number !== undefined;
  const blockId = typeof props.element.id === "string" ? props.element.id : "";
  const startsRun = startsFootnoteRun(props.editor.children, blockId);

  // SlateElement only renders attributes, so the anchor id goes through them.
  const attributes = {
    ...props.attributes,
    id: `fn-${footnoteId}`,
    "data-footnote-def": "",
    "data-footnote-id": footnoteId,
    ...(referenced ? {} : { "data-footnote-unreferenced": "" }),
  };

  return (
    <SlateElement
      {...props}
      attributes={attributes}
      className={cn(FOOTNOTE_DEF_CLASS, startsRun && FOOTNOTE_DEF_RUN_CLASS)}
    >
      {referenced ? (
        <span
          data-footnote-number=""
          className={cn(FOOTNOTE_NUMBER_CLASS, FOOTNOTE_NUMBER_LINK_CLASS)}
        >
          {number}.
        </span>
      ) : (
        <span data-footnote-number="" title="Not referenced" className={FOOTNOTE_NUMBER_CLASS}>
          –
        </span>
      )}
      <div className={FOOTNOTE_TEXT_CLASS}>{props.children}</div>
      {referenced ? (
        <a href={`#fnref-${footnoteId}-1`} aria-label="Back to reference">
          ↩
        </a>
      ) : null}
    </SlateElement>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/components/static/synced-static.tsx
```tsx
import { ElementApi, PathApi, type Descendant, type TElement } from "platejs";
import {
  createStaticEditor,
  PlateStatic,
  SlateElement,
  type SlateElementProps,
} from "platejs/static";

import { syncedTargetStatus } from "../../lib/features/editor-synced-repair";
import { editorStaticPlugins } from "../../lib/static/editor-static-plugins";

const FROM_ABOVE = "Synced from above";
const FROM_BELOW = "Synced from below";
const MISSING = "The original block was deleted.";
const INVALID = "Invalid reference";

function indexElements(value: readonly Descendant[]): Map<string, TElement> {
  const index = new Map<string, TElement>();
  const visit = (node: Descendant): void => {
    if (!ElementApi.isElement(node)) return;
    if (typeof node.id === "string" && node.id.length > 0 && !index.has(node.id)) {
      index.set(node.id, node);
    }
    node.children.forEach(visit);
  };
  value.forEach(visit);
  return index;
}

function pathOf(value: readonly Descendant[], id: string, path: number[] = []): number[] | null {
  for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) {
    const node = value[index];
    if (!ElementApi.isElement(node)) continue;
    const here = [...path, index];
    if (node.id === id) return here;
    const nested = pathOf(node.children, id, here);
    if (nested) return nested;
  }
  return null;
}

function previewTree(node: Descendant): Descendant {
  if (!ElementApi.isElement(node)) return node;
  const children = node.children.map((child) => previewTree(child));
  const copy: TElement = { ...node, children };
  if (
    (node.type === "h1" || node.type === "h2" || node.type === "h3") &&
    typeof node.id === "string" &&
    node.id.length > 0
  ) {
    copy.id = `preview-${node.id}`;
  }
  return copy;
}

export function SyncedStatic(props: SlateElementProps) {
  const targetId =
    typeof props.element.targetBlockId === "string" ? props.element.targetBlockId : "";
  const value = props.editor.children;
  const index = indexElements(value);
  const target = index.get(targetId);
  const status = syncedTargetStatus(target, targetId);
  const refId = typeof props.element.id === "string" ? props.element.id : "";
  const refPath = pathOf(value, refId) ?? [];
  const targetPath = pathOf(value, targetId);
  const label =
    status === "live" && targetPath
      ? PathApi.compare(targetPath, refPath) < 0
        ? FROM_ABOVE
        : FROM_BELOW
      : undefined;
  const preview =
    status === "live" && target && ElementApi.isElement(previewTree(target))
      ? (previewTree(target) as TElement)
      : null;
  const previewEditor = preview
    ? createStaticEditor({ plugins: editorStaticPlugins, value: [preview] })
    : null;

  return (
    <SlateElement
      {...props}
      className="group border-border relative my-2 max-w-full min-w-0 rounded-md border-s ps-3"
    >
      <div data-synced-ref="" data-synced-state={status}>
        {label === undefined ? null : (
          <p data-synced-label className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">
            {label}
          </p>
        )}
        {previewEditor ? (
          <div data-synced-preview className="pointer-events-none max-w-full min-w-0">
            <PlateStatic editor={previewEditor} className="contents" />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
            {status === "missing" ? MISSING : INVALID}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
      {props.children}
    </SlateElement>
  );
}
```

## packages/core/src/components/blocks/notion-like-editor/notion-like-editor-static.tsx
```tsx
import { createStaticEditor, PlateStatic } from "platejs/static";

import type { EditorValue } from "./lib/document/editor-value";
import { editorStaticPlugins } from "./lib/static/editor-static-plugins";
import { readStaticValue } from "./lib/static/read-static-value";

export type NotionLikeEditorStaticProps = {
  value: EditorValue;
  className?: string;
};

export function NotionLikeEditorStatic({ value, className }: NotionLikeEditorStaticProps) {
  const content = readStaticValue(value);
  if (content === null) {
    return <div className={className} />;
  }

  const editor = createStaticEditor({
    plugins: editorStaticPlugins,
    value: content,
  });

  const surface = className ? `${className} whitespace-pre-wrap` : "whitespace-pre-wrap";
  return <PlateStatic editor={editor} className={surface} />;
}
```

```tsx
      return (
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-full min-h-full w-full max-w-[var(--editor-max-width,700px)] min-w-0 flex-col">
          <mod.NotionLikeEditorStatic
            value={DEMO_DOCUMENT_VALUE}
            className={`text-foreground min-h-full w-full min-w-0 space-y-4 py-8 text-base leading-relaxed wrap-break-word outline-none sm:py-12 ${LIST_SIBLING_GAP_CLASS}`}
          />
        </div>
      );
    },
  })),
);

let demoAdapter: EditorPersistenceAdapter | undefined;

function subscribe(): () => void {
  return () => undefined;
}

function getDemoAdapter(): EditorPersistenceAdapter {
  if (demoAdapter !== undefined) {
    return demoAdapter;
  }

  demoAdapter = createLocalStorageAdapter();
  try {
    removeStaleDemoDocuments(window.localStorage, DEMO_DOCUMENT_ID);
  } catch {
    // Reading localStorage can throw. The editor still opens on the current id.
  }

  return demoAdapter;
}

function getServerDemoAdapter(): undefined {
  return undefined;
}

function readReadonlyFlag(): boolean {
  return new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("readonly") === "1";
}

function readReadonlyServer(): boolean {
  return false;
}

function readStaticFlag(): boolean {
  return new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("static") === "1";
}

function readStaticServer(): boolean {
  return false;
}

export function NotionLikeEditorDemo() {
  const adapter = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getDemoAdapter, getServerDemoAdapter);
  const readOnly = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, readReadonlyFlag, readReadonlyServer);
  const staticView = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, readStaticFlag, readStaticServer);

  if (staticView) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-background h-full min-h-full w-full min-w-0 px-4">
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <StaticDocument />
        </Suspense>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!adapter) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-background h-full min-h-full w-full min-w-0 px-4">
        <EditorDocumentSkeleton />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <NotionLikeEditorBlock
      documentId={DEMO_DOCUMENT_ID}
      adapter={adapter}
      initialValue={DEMO_DOCUMENT_VALUE}
      linkPreview={demoLinkPreviewAdapter}
      mentionProvider={demoMentionProvider}
      pageProvider={demoPageProvider}
      fileUpload={demoFileUploadAdapter}
      readOnly={readOnly}
    />
  );
}
```
